jobs.description:
About Huzzle  At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with exciting opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. We work with a diverse range of clients, including startups, digital agencies, and technology-driven businesses across industries such as SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and AI.  Unlike traditional outsourcing agencies, we place you directly with our clients, where you become an integral, in-house member of their team.

Job Type:  Full-time

Location:  Remote

Job Summary  As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. You will collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure data is reliable, accessible, and of high quality across the organisation.  This is a great opportunity for professionals who enjoy tackling complex data challenges and building robust systems that power business intelligence, analytics, and machine learning initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL and ELT data pipelines.  Develop and optimize data architectures, databases, and data warehouses.  Integrate data from various sources, APIs, and third-party platforms.  Maintain data quality, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and security.  Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data pipelines and workflows.  Work closely with analytics, engineering, and business teams to identify and meet data requirements.  Establish data governance standards and best practices for data management.  Improve data storage, processing speeds, and query performance.  Support business intelligence, reporting, and analytics projects.  Maintain documentation of data models, workflows, and technical processes.

Requirements

2+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or a similar field.  Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of database management.  Proficiency in Python, Java, Scala, or other relevant programming languages.  Practical experience with ETL/ELT tools and building data pipelines.  Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.  Hands-on experience with modern data warehouse solutions such as Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or Databricks.  Knowledge of workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect.  Understanding of data modelling, governance, and data quality best practices.  Experience handling large datasets and working with distributed systems is an advantage.  Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication abilities.  Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a remote team.

Benefits

💰  Competitive compensation:  Tailored to your experience, technical skills, and location.  🌎  Fully remote work:  Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere.  🚀  Career development:  Join innovative companies and contribute to meaningful, high-impact projects.  📈  Long-term potential:  Grow

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Germany.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Germany.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, IC

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Germany.

We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.

Accountabilities

You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.

Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning.

Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls.

Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data.

Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV.

Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams.

Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis.

Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories.

Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries.

Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails.

Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping.

Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.

Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability.

Requirements

The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hand

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability

At  Hypersonica , we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.

By joining  Hypersonica , you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.

We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

Stand up and run a lean, effective Quality Management System suitable for a fast-iterating hypersonic hardware programme, aligned to an AS9100 pathway without adding bureaucracy.

Own the nonconformance process end to end: containment, root cause, corrective actions, and prevention (NCR, MRB, concessions) with tight turnaround times.

Build the quality backbone for prototype to flight hardware, including inspection planning, traceability, and documentation discipline that supports test and readiness reviews.

Drive supplier quality for critical components: onboarding criteria, audits (as needed), incoming inspection standards, supplier performance tracking, and rapid resolution of escapes.

Partner with engineering and manufacturing to embed DFM/DFA + quality by design early, so we don’t “inspect quality in” later.

Define and maintain pragmatic measurement and calibration controls (as appropriate) and ensure controlled processes for special processes where relevant.

Create simple quality dashboards that leadership actually uses: escape rate, NCR cycle time, top defect drivers, supplier OTD/quality trends.

Be hands-on in the build. When something is off, you are on the floor with the team finding the truth and driving the fix.

Who you are

Quality engineer with 4+ years experience in aerospace, defence, advanced manufacturing, motorsport, or other high-consequence hardware environments.

Deeply practical: you can run a QMS, but you care more about real outcomes than paperwork.

Experienced in NCR/MRB/concessions and closing corrective actions fast with strong root cause discipline.

Comfortable operating around flight-critical / safety-critical hardware with traceability and evidence requirements.

Supplier-quality capable: you can hold suppliers to a high bar without slowing the programme.

Strong judgement: you know when to apply rigor and when to keep it minimal so the team stays fast.

Comfortable in ambiguity and pace

jobs.title: Product Manager - Post Booking
jobs.description:
About BlaBlaCar

BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 40 million active members to share rides across 41 countries each year. Its technology matches drivers with empty seats with passengers heading the same way, so they can share the cost of the trip.

BlaBlaCar’s mission is to be the go-to marketplace for shared travel, bringing carpooling, buses, and trains together in one place. Globally, the BlaBlaCar Group also includes Obilet, the leading online bus ticketing platform in Turkey. By partnering with over 20,000 operators, the Group offers a wide choice of affordable and sustainable transport solutions.

In 2025, the BlaBlaCar community connected 2.7 million meeting points worldwide and enabled 138 million connections between travelers. Drivers saved 568 million euros by carpooling, and all of the BlaBlaCar Group’s mobility services contributed to avoiding 4 million tonnes of CO2 emissions.

Your Mission

As the Product Manager for Post-booking, you will shape the experience passengers have after making a booking, from managing their trips to getting the help they need before, during and after their journey.

You will make post-booking a clear, reliable and useful part of the end-to-end BlaBlaCar experience across carpooling, bus and train. You will help passengers feel informed and in control, while reducing friction for our Customer Relationship Teams (CRT) and supporting the growth of our multimodal marketplace.

You will co-lead the Post-booking squad with an Engineering Manager and work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Customer Relationship and our supply stakeholders.

Your Responsibilities

Shape the post-booking vision and roadmap:  Set a clear direction for the passenger experience after purchase, translating BlaBlaCar’s product strategy and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Take full responsibility for your scope, from strategy through execution.

Improve the post-booking passenger experience:  Identify opportunities to strengthen passenger satisfaction and trust by helping people find the information they need, manage their bookings and feel supported throughout their journey. You will lead the end-to-end product discoveries for those opportunities.

Optimize CRT contact rate:  Partner with CRT teams to understand why passengers get in touch. Improve information on the platform and self-service so passengers can resolve issues with less effort. In particular, you will take over product leadership of our member-facing AI assistant.

Use insights to guide decisions:  Bring together customer feedback, product data and business context to identify opportunities, set priorities and evaluate impact using appropriate KPIs.

Build alignment across teams:  Act as the go-to product partner for Post-booking topics. Communicate the strategy, formalize major decisions and align leadership, Engineering, Design, CRT and other stakeholders.

Your Qualifications

Experience : 3+ years in Prod

Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026.

Our Impact:

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. As Product Marketing Manager, you shape how the market understands our portfolio: positioning, differentiation and outside-in stories that turn complex legal tech into value buyers recognise, and that drive pipeline and revenue.

Update and evolve ICPs, personas and use cases.

Inform product and GTM direction based on market opportunity and customer reality.

Positioning and messaging

Apply positioning, differentiation and value propositions across all content and assets, internal and external.

Translate product capabilities into compelling, customer-centric narratives.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in France.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.

Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICC

About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.  We’re looking for a top‑tier  Machine Learning Engineer  to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO,  Denis Charrier , and the rest of the tech team.  Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in  Linkup’s mission

Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

Example Projects

Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.  We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details  here .  Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

About Linkup

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic has done pioneering work examining the economic impacts of AI. The AI & Rule of Law team takes an analogous approach to a different question: how will AI affect our constitutional democratic institutions?

Increasingly powerful AI systems will put pressure on societal functions at every level — the courts, legislatures, electoral systems, oversight bodies, and the legal frameworks that hold democratic governance together. Our team exists to ask hard questions about those vulnerabilities, and to seek out strategies for protecting democratic freedoms — in the short and long term, through both technical and policy levers.

This is early, high-stakes research. The team is small, the problems are genuinely unsolved, and the work will matter.

We are looking for someone with deep expertise in both AI and at least one of: law, government, political science, or public policy. jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.  As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.  Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if… 
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if… 
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

Track record of taking pow

At least five years of relevant process safety experience within oil and gas, renewable fuels, chemicals, or another major hazard environment.

Practical knowledge of SEVESO III requirements and their application within Major Accident Hazard facilities.

Strong technical expertise in HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, Management of Change, Mechanical Integrity, contractor management, and commissioning or start-up activities.

You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

jobs.description:
About us

Infinite Lambda is a data and AI consultancy that helps the world’s leading companies become data-first. We design and build modern, cloud-native data platforms, and we help our clients turn them into real business value with AI.  We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, and we’re now a global team across three regions. Headquartered in London, we have engineers and consultants in the United States, the UK, France, Italy, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania, Bulgaria, Vietnam and Singapore. We’re also building new teams in Brazil, Argentina and Chile.  Our mission is to bring exceptional people together to make an impact where technology meets sustainable growth. You’ll work alongside experts in dbt, Snowflake and the wider modern data stack on complex, meaningful projects, in a culture built on curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning.  We’re a diverse team, and we want everyone to feel comfortable being themselves at work. If you want to grow fast, learn constantly and help shape where we go next, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role

Every enterprise wants to be AI-ready, and most are held back by legacy data estates built over decades. As Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead, you’ll own how Infinite Lambda solves that problem: moving the world’s largest organisations off Informatica, Talend, SSIS/SQL Server, DataStage, stored procedures and, increasingly, SAS and Alteryx, onto modern platforms ready for AI.  Enterprise migrations are a core pillar of our growth strategy, and this role sets the standard for how we deliver them globally. The practice spans the full migration lifecycle:

Assess:  Estate discovery, feasibility analysis and migration strategy, ending in a fixed-cost, fixed-timeline proposal that gives clients certainty from day one.

Convert:  Automated code conversion with Flowline, our proprietary product, which combines deterministic and LLM-assisted methods. This stage also covers refactoring, optimisation and a first-pass ontology that lays the foundation for AI use cases.

Validate:  Reconciliation architecture and row-level sign-off, so every migration is provably correct.

The first part is  delivery excellence that compounds . You’ll make sure every migration we deliver is better than the last. That means defining the standards, building the playbooks and reusable assets, and turning the lessons from each strategic engagement into capability across the practice. You’ll also develop the engineers and leads who carry that standard across AMER, EMEA and APAC.  The second part is  commercial impact . You’ll turn delivery quality into a competitive edge: faster delivery, sharper scoping and pricing, and healthy margins you can measure and report on. Working closely with Sales and Solution Engineering, you’ll shape the offer that makes Infinite Lambda the obvious choice for enterprise migration, anywhere in the world.

jobs.description:
IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)

Krumbach-Niederraunau, Bayern · Hybrid · Vollzeit, unbefristet

Über Everfield

Everfield übernimmt, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Unsere Mission: Ambitionen fördern, Wachstum vorantreiben und Chancen für Europas Software-Ökosystem eröffnen.  Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem arbeiten dezentral: Sie behalten ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte und konzentrieren sich auf das, was sie am besten können – Produkte entwickeln und Kunden betreuen. Everfield unterstützt mit Talent Acquisition, HR und einem Expertenteam, das zu Finanz- und Operations-Themen berät. Seit der Gründung 2022 ist Everfield in  neun  Ländern vertreten, Tendenz steigend.

Über SoCom

Die SoCom Informationssysteme GmbH entwickelt mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden TIKOS, die führende ERP-Lösung für gewerbliche Wäschereien und Textildienstleister. Mit rund 40 % Marktanteil in der DACH-Region und über 30 Jahren Erfahrung steuern Kunden mit TIKOS ihre gesamte Prozesskette, von der Wäscheannahme über RFID-Tracking bis zur Auslieferung. Seit Oktober 2026 gehört auch die Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH zur SoCom-Familie. SoCom ist Teil des Everfield-Ökosystems.

Über die Rolle

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte IT: die interne Infrastruktur, die Informationssicherheit und die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für unsere Kunden betreiben. Viele dieser Leistungen haben wir bisher extern eingekauft. Jetzt holen wir das Know-how ins Haus – und du stellst die IT so auf, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum, der Integration neuer Unternehmensteile und steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen Schritt hält.  Du bist Gestalter:in und Macher:in zugleich: Du entwickelst die IT-Strategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an.

Deine Aufgaben

•  IT-Verantwortung und Strategie:  Du verantwortest die IT von SoCom ganzheitlich, entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Roadmap und steuerst das IT-Budget für Hardware, Lizenzen, Cloud und Dienstleister.  •  Insourcing und Dienstleistersteuerung:  Du überführst bisher extern erbrachte Leistungen – Netzwerk, Firewall, Server, Backup und E-Mail-Security – schrittweise in die eigene Verantwortung. Verbleibende Dienstleister und Verträge steuerst du über klare SLAs.  •  Cloud und Hosting:  Du betreibst die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für Kunden hosten, und entwickelst sie weiter. Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb und Support kalkulierst du Hosting-Angebote, verantwortest Verfügbarkeit, Kapazität und Kosten und treibst eine zukunftsfähige Hosting-Architektur voran.  •  Infrastruktur und Betrieb:  Du verantwortest Server, Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und Disaster Recovery – am Standort und in der Cloud – sowie Microsoft 365, Endgeräte, Telefonie und Mobilfunk. Monitoring und Patch-Management steuerst du über ein RMM-Tool.  •  Informationssicherhe

jobs.title: Senior AI R&D Engineer – Model Training  (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission  Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released  Kolibri-1 model . Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

Team Culture  At Aleph Alpha, we foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose.  We believe a strong engineering culture is the key to model training success. We like Extreme Programming and favor trunk-based development. We often mob-program, which keeps us aligned and means we always learn from each other.

About the Role  As a  Senior

AI R&D Engineer in Model Training (f/m/d),  you will join our model training team in Heidelberg or Berlin. Most of the team is based in Heidelberg. The model training team is building and improving our model training pipeline, which has been used to train Kolibri.

You will work across our full stack. Some weeks you might be optimizing how training loads are scheduled on our cluster and making the pipeline more robust and performant so we can iterate faster. Other weeks, you will be enabling large-scale code execution for reinforcement learning. And at other times, you might dig deep into our evaluation codebase to lift inference throughput on evals.

No two days are the same. Things move fast, and your ability to focus and prioritize is what lets you unblock the team day-to-day while designing the high-quality tooling and infrastructure that speeds us up long-term.

We're still building out our training pipeline and infrastructure. Some pieces exist, some do not, and you will have real influence on what gets built and how. Your work directly shapes how quickly we can experiment and improve our models.

Identifying issues and taking initiative is what drives our day-to-day work.

Working mode, design decisions, priorities are all done in your team together with your team mates. 
The strongest teams often use highly collaborative techniques, like mob or pair programming.

Due to the highly collaborative nature of our work you are expected to be on-site at least two days a week. If you are in Berlin, you should expect to travel around every second month for a few days to Heidelberg.

We are specifically looking to strengthen the Software Engineering in the teams which are research heavy. Major points include improving the maintainability of our code through tests and design & architecture changes.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Southern Africa
jobs.description:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.  Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Frontu

Frontu is a B2B SaaS Field Service Management (FSM) platform built for the companies that keep the world running - heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, material handling, and mining. Our platform digitises field operations for 7,000+ technicians across 20 countries, plugging directly into existing ERP systems as a powerful mobile layer.  We are part of Everfield, a European private equity group that builds and grows vertical SaaS businesses. Through Everfield, you will be joining a network of 1,000+ professionals across Europe with shared knowledge, resources, and commercial muscle behind you, but at the same time will work with a small 20 person team at Frontu.  We are now expanding into Southern Africa. Frontu is already used by a few companies in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Indian Ocean islands so we need local support in the region.

The Role

This is a hunter role. You will own new business development across Southern Africa. We already have customers in Southern Africa and early traction across the region - proof that the market works. We also come with a mapped prospect database covering the region. What we do not have yet is someone pushing things forward at the pace this opportunity deserves.  This is not a role for someone who needs everything built for them. The foundation is there - customers, data, product. What it needs is someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and turns existing signals into closed deals.

What You Will Do

Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and outbound outreach to discovery, demo, proposal, and close

Build pipeline through targeted outbound, referrals, industry events, and partner channels in heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, and material handling verticals

Run consultative discovery with your core champions - aftersales directors, service managers, and C-level executives - understand their ERP landscape and position Frontu as the field service layer their technicians are missing

Deliver tailored demos and ROI-driven proposals adapted to the buyer context

Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts in CRM (Pipedrive) - we run a tight ship

Work closely with Head of Sales on GTM strategy, pricing, and market feedback loops

Hand close

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and results driven Sales Development Representative to join our growing SaaS business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and manage a pipeline of sales opportunities across the utilities sector, including telecommunications, water, gas, electricity, and EV infrastructure. You will be responsible for generating outbound leads, nurturing prospects, and converting opportunities into long term customers. The ideal candidate is an energetic, proactive individual who thrives on building relationships, enjoys the challenge of cold outreach, and is eager to make a meaningful impact on business growth.

jobs.title: Gestionnaire Paie & RH H/F
jobs.description:
À propos d'Everfield

Everfield achète, développe et accompagne la croissance d'éditeurs de logiciels métiers et spécialisés en Europe, en leur donnant les clés pour franchir un cap. Notre mission : nourrir l'ambition, alimenter la croissance et révéler le potentiel de l'écosystème logiciel européen.  Les entreprises de l'écosystème Everfield évoluent selon un modèle décentralisé : elles conservent leur équipe, leur marque et leurs bureaux, et se concentrent sur ce qu'elles font de mieux, développer leurs produits et accompagner leurs clients. Everfield les épaule sur le recrutement et les RH, et leur donne accès à une équipe d'experts qui les conseille sur les aspects financiers et opérationnels de la construction et de la croissance des entreprises B2B SaaS européennes. Fondé en 2022, Everfield est déjà présent dans 10 pays, et continue de se développer.

Rôle

En tant que Gestionnaire Paie & RH, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans le bon fonctionnement des opérations RH au sein des sociétés du portefeuille ( sous la convention Syntec). En étroite collaboration avec l'équipe HR Business Partnering Europe, vous gérerez l'administration RH, coordonnerez la paie et fournirez des données et rapports précis pour appuyer la prise de décision. Vous travaillez avec un prestataire de paie externe.  Vous serez le premier point de contact pour les questions RH quotidiennes des collaborateurs, en garantissant un support RH rapide, précis et conforme. Ce rôle constitue le socle d'une gestion RH efficace, permettant aux dirigeants et aux HRBP de se concentrer sur les priorités stratégiques.

Responsabilités clés (liste non exhaustive)

Paie  : préparer, contrôler et valider la paie mensuelle de plusieurs entités avec le prestataire externe ; gérer la DSN, les arrêts maladie, maternité et invalidité, la subrogation, la relation avec la CPAM, la mutuelle et la prévoyance ; mettre à jour les taux de cotisation et appliquer les minima et règles Syntec.

Administration RH  : contrats et avenants, absences, avantages sociaux, dossiers du personnel prêts pour un audit.

Gestion des intégrations et des sorties  : piloter le cycle d'entrée et de sortie des collaborateurs de bout en bout.

Intégrations  : DPAE, contrat de travail, affiliation mutuelle et prévoyance, visite d'information et de prévention, création dans le SIRH et la paie, coordination de l'accueil avec les managers et suivi de la période d'essai.

Sorties  : démissions, ruptures conventionnelles (homologation), licenciements, fins de période d'essai ; calcul du préavis et des indemnités selon Syntec, solde de tout compte, certificat de travail, attestation France Travail, portabilité mutuelle et prévoyance, restitution du matériel et clôture des accès.

Premier point de contact RH  pour les collaborateurs, en français et en anglais.

Données et reporting  : fiabilité des données dans le SIRH (Workday) et rapports pour les équipes RH et Finance, en anglais.

Appui aux HRBP  : documentation disciplinaire

Ervaring met het implementeren en bewaken van beleid, regelingen en processen.

Sterk analytisch vermogen, zorgvuldige oordeelsvorming en resultaatgerichtheid.

Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om belanghebbenden mee te nemen.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post Doctoral Open and Flexible System-Level Evaluation Framework for Emerging AI Computing Architectures
jobs.description:
Emerging computing technologies – non-volatile and ferroelectric memories, analog and digital in-memory computing, silicon photonics, 3D integration, and heterogeneous chiplets – offer major gains in energy efficiency, latency, bandwidth, and functionality. Their potential cannot, however, be established from device or circuit results alone: it requires a rigorous link between technology characteristics, architectural choices, workload mapping, and application-level figures of merit.

The Electronics group at the Lyon Institute of Nanotechnology (INL) is seeking a (m/f) postdoctoral researcher to develop an open, modular and extensible system-level evaluation framework for design space exploration (DSE) and system-design-technology co-optimization (SDTCO) of emerging computing architectures. The focus is at the interface of computer architecture, accelerator design, performance modelling and hardware-software codesign, while making systematic use of lower-level device, circuit and array results so that architectural conclusions remain physically credible.

The objective is to convert low-level results – compact models, measured or simulated KPIs, variability and reliability constraints, and multi-objective Pareto fronts – into parameterized architectural models supporting efficient exploration of accelerators for emerging AI workloads. The framework must enable both bottom-up projection, from device/circuit/array choices toward system performance, and top-down constraint propagation, from targets for energy, latency, throughput, accuracy, robustness and area toward technology and circuit requirements. It will consolidate ongoing INL activities in predictive system assessment, DTCO, emerging memories, compute-in-memory and photonic computing, integrating or extending existing components with emphasis on openness, reproducibility and reusability.

A core scientific challenge is to represent cross-layer trade-offs without hiding their origin: rather than isolated energy or latency numbers, the framework should expose bottlenecks, sensitivities, feasibility limits, break-even points and opportunities and identify the regimes in which a technology becomes advantageous. Target workloads span edge inference through to transformer-inspired models, with use cases in vision, audio and sensor processing, sparse and vector/matrix operations, and on-device learning.

Expected outcomes: a maintainable evaluation environment combining fast exploration with selected higherfidelity validation paths; cross-layer models and interface contracts, reusable data schemes, benchmarking flows, system-level Pareto analyses and design guidelines for emerging AI accelerators – a decision-support instrument for future research projects.

Candidate profile: PhD in Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with a strong background in several of: computer architecture and AI accelerators; performance, energy and area mo

Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

Spreedly is hiring a  Senior Database Engineer  to become the go-to database expert on our Reliability team. You'll improve the performance and reliability of our existing distributed database environment and help engineering teams make database changes safely.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and "senior" here means more than years of experience: you'll be the person the rest of engineering looks to on anything at the database layer. The opportunity is to shape how we manage and improve our databases, not to lead a migration. We already run CockroachDB, with infrastructure operated through Cockroach Labs' managed service. That means your focus is the part that's ours to own: workload, schema, queries, settings, capacity, and the practices around change.

Our Reliability team works across application engineering, infrastructure, and platform to improve monitoring, prevent incidents, and recover quickly when incidents happen. It isn't a textbook SRE team. It's a small, highly autonomous group focused on continuous improvement, with real room to see a problem, propose a fix, and carry it through within the team's priorities. Database availability and performance matter a great deal in a payments environment, and the improvements you make here show up directly in the reliability our customers depend on.

  • AI Frontier 본부 구성원들은 직급과 연차에 상관없이 의견을 내고, 결정하면 빠르게 실행합니다. 장애를 겪으면 숨기지 않고 포스트모템으로 시스템을 더 단단하게 만들고, 아키텍처와 실험 결과와 의사결정 과정을 문서로 남깁니다. AI 도구를 일상적인 개발·운영 도구로 쓰며, 새로운 모델과 서빙 기술이 나오면 바로 써보고 프로덕션에 적용할 방법을 찾는 문화를 지향합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • Inference fleet과 control plane 소유
    • 추론 플랫폼의 기술 방향과 주요 기술 의사결정을 책임지는 Lead로서 자체 모델과 오픈웨이트 모델(음성·멀티모달 포함)을 위한 서빙 플랫폼을 설계하고, 구축·운영 체계를 수립하며 팀의 실행을 이끕니다.
    • 서빙 엔진과 오케스트레이션 계층을 선택하고, 요청 라우팅, 용량·모델·캐시 배치, 오토스케일링, 멀티 모델·멀티 테넌트 운영 정책을 포함한 기술 로드맵과 운영 표준을 수립합니다.
  • 조직 구축과 협업 구조 정립
    • 팀을 직접 채용·육성하고, AI Research의 컴퓨팅 최적화 R&D 조직, 사내 추론 서비스를 운영하는 IT 조직, 각 사업 Squad 사이의 단일 접점 역할을 합니다.
    • 프로덕션의 워크로드 프로파일과 병목을 R&D 요구사항으로 구체화하고, 연구 결과를 검증·인수·배포하는 루프를 만듭니다.
  • 안전한 모델 온보딩과 플랫폼 경험 제공
    • 새 모델의 성능·품질 회귀 테스트, 릴리즈 자동화, 카나리·롤백, API gateway의 인증·쿼터·rate limit, 토큰 단위 관측성을 구축합니다.
    • 사업 Squad와 모델 개발자가 모델을 빠르고 일관되게 온보딩할 수 있는 셀프서비스 도구와 가이드를 제공합니다.
  • SLO와 운영 신뢰성 확립
    • TTFT·TPOT·end-to-end latency의 p95·p99, 가용성, 에러율, 처리량 등 워크로드별 SLO와 error budget을 각 Squad와 함께 정합니다.
    • 온콜, 장애 대응, 포스트모템, capacity event 대응, deploy safety를 포함한 운영

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Workloads
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

About the Team

Launchables is CoreWeave's platform for building Physical Intelligence. We bring simulation, training and evaluation tools into a common platform, allowing robotics, autonomous systems and engineering teams to focus on their applications while Launchables handles common execution and infrastructure needs.

We turn specialist Physical AI software into capabilities that researchers and engineers can use, adapt and build upon. Our work combines strong software engineering with applied domain knowledge to make complex workloads accessible, reproducible and useful in real-world environments.

As a Staff Software Engineer, Workloads - Physical AI, you will develop engine integrations, application code, adapters, templates and developer tools that make specialist software available through Launchables. You will work directly with researchers and engineers to understand their tasks, assumptions, dependencies and expected outcomes, translating these into interfaces and configurations that preserve the capabilities they need.

You will take ownership of how users configure, run, customise and evaluate workloads. This includes defining meaningful inputs, defaults, constraints and outputs; building command-line and API interfaces; and creating examples and documentation that help users extend existing templates or author their own. You will establish appropriate validation for packaging, execution and application outcomes, working with domain specialists to make evaluation criteria and their limitations clear.

You will profile workloads to improve preparation time, GPU utilisation, concurrency and data movement while preserving the intended computation. You will also capture the inputs, versions, settings and execution conditions needed to reproduce runs, with logs, metrics and artefacts that help users diagnose failures, compare experiments and interpret results.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The Physical AI Engineering Team at CoreWeave is building the software and infrastructure that enables demanding AI, simulation, robotics, and engineering workloads to run reliably at scale.

As these workloads become more complex, the challenge is no longer simply providing compute. We need to make heterogeneous workloads easier to execute, observe, reproduce, and move across different systems without hiding the capabilities or semantics of the infrastructure underneath them.

About the role:

We’re seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Runtime Systems to help design and build this layer.

This is a hands-on systems engineering role at the intersection of distributed systems, runtimes, workflow execution, programming language concepts, and large-scale compute infrastructure.

You’ll work on the foundations that allow complex workloads to move from an abstract description into reliable execution across systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, OSMO, and future execution environments.

A major part of the role is deciding where abstraction is useful — and where it creates more complexity. Rather than building another universal workflow engine, you’ll help establish clear contracts between our platform and the systems that execute work, while preserving native capabilities.

You’ll operate across architecture and implementation: defining contracts, writing production software, validating assumptions against real workloads, and working closely with platform and infrastructure teams.

In this role, you will:

  • Runtime Systems & Architecture
  • Design and build runtime components for complex AI, simulation, and engineering workloads.
  • Define abstractions for workloads, execution environments, dependencies, state, capabilities, and failure.
  • Design interfaces between higher-level services and systems such as Kubernetes, Argo, and OSMO.

Scopely is looking for a Sr. Director Business Development to join our Global Publishing team!

The Business Development team is responsible for business negotiations, partner management, and new expansion opportunities with our largest IP partners, new distribution platforms (e.g. storefronts, hardware manufacturers, subscription services, etc.), and digital payment partners (e.g. Stripe, Visa, Checkout.com, etc.) around the world.   • Ability to identify and negotiate large scale commercial agreements
  • Gaming experience preferred, and particularly free-to-play games
  • Passion & love for video games
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and all levels of management
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changes
  • Ability to analyze data to make data-driven decisions - skills in Excel and Google Sheets necessary

jobs.title: Chief of Staff Intern
jobs.description:
What is Finary?  Money is broken. Most people's wealth sits in products they did not choose, with fees they cannot see, and a private banker costs more than they will ever pay. We are putting one in everyone's pocket: the same quality of advice for a €10K saver and a €10M client.

Mounir  launched Finary in 2021, and more than 1M people now track their wealth with us, for free. Finary AI turns that financial context into a plan, and our own investment products and in-house wealth advisors (Finary One) make it real: clarity on what you have, guidance on where you are going, action to get there.

Why now?  AI makes this vision possible, and 3 things make it hard to copy:

Data:  years of per-user financial history, goals and risk profiles that no public dataset holds.

Brand:  half of our new users come from our own channels, and 1 signup in 5 names our YouTube channel.

Licences:  stocks, ETFs and crypto on one regulated platform, passportable across Europe. We started early, when a simple registration was enough: PSAN in 2022, Investment Firm licence in March 2026, MiCA in July 2026. Since July, every crypto platform in Europe must be licensed or stop.

Many fintechs will have the AI, and a few will have the licences. We have all 3. We raised €40M from Hedosophia, Y Combinator and Speedinvest, alongside founders and operators like Steve Anavi & Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (former UBS Chairman) and Harsh Sinha (CTO at Wise). There's never been a more exciting time to join.

What we offer

We're 70 builders who genuinely love what they do: real ownership from day one, tier-1 salary and equity, offices in the heart of Paris with hybrid remote, and quarterly gatherings we actually look forward to.  We hire A-players who are as kind as they are demanding, people whose ideas transform not just our product but the way we work and think. Our culture is direct, transparent, and built on radical candor: we challenge each other openly, then commit. And we don't hedge on AI. It's the single most important skill of the next decade and a real bar here. Everyone at Finary has rebuilt how they work around it. If that's already second nature to you, you'll be surrounded by people pushing that frontier every day.  Read more about our values  here .  The role  The CEO Office owns Finary's most important strategic projects, the delivery of the business plan, company’s operating rituals and runs the board and investor relations. Today one Chief of Staff carries all of it. You join as a real partner: you own a share of these projects from day one and move key topics forward fast, side by side with the Chief of Staff and the CEO.  What you will do

Take one area of the company and measurably improve its metrics.

Lead the analyses behind big decisions: business plan updates, international expansion, new offers and segments. You turn a question into a recommendation the leadership team can act on.

Run the board

About Us:
 AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.  Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like

Ramp  , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

The Role:  We’re hiring an Account Executive to win and grow Modal’s relationships with AI-native companies: the startups and scale-ups building their products on models from day one. These teams move fast, so our sales cycle does too. Deals often move forward from the very first call, and you’ll usually be talking directly with the founder or technical leader who owns the budget.

You’ll own the full cycle, from sourcing to close to expansion, and you’ll partner closely with our founders, engineering, and product teams. You’ll also help build Modal’s presence in the developer community, because in this market, the best pipeline comes from engineers who already love the product.

The ideal candidate has an engineering background, has worked as a solutions architect or in a similar technical role, and has since moved into selling. You’re as comfortable debugging a cold-start issue with an ML engineer as you are negotiating terms with a CEO.

What You’ll Do:

Own a book of AI-native accounts and close new business quickly, often moving from first call to signed deal in weeks rather than quarters.

Sell directly to founders, CTOs, and heads of ML who define the ideal customer and hold the budget from day one.

Get hands-on in technical conversations: scope workloads, set up quick proofs of concept, and show customers how Modal fits into their stack.

Spot expansion early and help fast-growing customers scale their inference, training, and sandbox workloads as their usage takes off.

Help build and engage Modal’s developer community through events, meetups, open-source channels, and word of mouth.

Bring sharp, structured customer feedback to our product and engineering teams to shape the roadmap.

Help define how Modal sells to AI-native companies, including the playbooks, pricing motions, and processes we’ll scale as the team grows.

jobs.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

Together with the team, you will shape the software layer of our closed-loop discovery workflow: our agents propose experiments, partner labs execute them, and the results feed back into our models to guide the next set of experiments.  This role sits between lab automation and production engineering. You will bring hands-on experience with scientific or lab automation, and the engineering discipline to make those integrations secure, reliable and scalable across many partners.  You will be part of a small team of materials scientists, ML engineers and software engineers, working closely with each other and with our partner labs. You will turn experimental labs into first-class, programmable parts of the CuspAI platform. Every partner you onboard, and every integration you harden, shortens the loop between an AI-generated hypothesis and a validated material.

Integrate with lab instruments, robotic platforms, LIMS/ELN systems and scheduling software, translating between disparate formats and CuspAI's data platform.

Make integrations reliable at scale: idempotency, retries, queueing, monitoring and alerting across many partners and time zones.

jobs.title: Solution Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At  RelationalAI , we’re solving one of the most important challenges in artificial intelligence: how to teach large language models the logic, semantics, and business context of the modern enterprise.

Frontier models are trained almost entirely on public data — they can speak about the world, but they don’t understand  your  business. We fix that.

RelationalAI has pioneered a breakthrough called  Superalignment  — technology that enables LLMs to learn natively from  private, structured enterprise data  inside the data cloud.

By combining this with  relational knowledge graphs  and our proprietary  neuro/symbolic-relational reasoners , we deliver  trustworthy decision intelligence : systems that use semantic models to truly understand how a business operates and can reason across its data to drive better outcomes.

We’re a globally distributed team of engineers, scientists, and builders redefining how AI learns from data. We believe that  high-stakes decisions deserve frontier intelligence  — intelligence that’s explainable, aligned, and grounded in reality.

If you’re driven by curiosity, thrive in complexity, and want to help build the system that brings  true understanding  to enterprise AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Role

You will be embedded inside our customers' hardest problems, and you will own the outcome until it works in production.

You'll sit with executives, domain experts, and data teams to find the decisions that actually move their business - inventory that's in the wrong place, risk concentrations nobody can see, fraud patterns that only emerge across three systems, capacity plans built on guesses. Then you'll model their world in our ontology, formulate the reasoning problem, write the PyRel, and ship something that runs against their real data in their own Snowflake account.

Every engagement here produces two deliverables.

The first is the one the customer sees: a working decision system that changes how they operate.

The second is the one that matters most to us: the pile of things you had to invent because our platform didn't have them yet. The modelling pattern you hand-rolled. The constraint formulation that should have been a primitive. The three-hour workaround where an API should have existed. You bring those back, you argue for them, and the strongest of them become product.

That second deliverable is why this role exists. If you only ever deliver the first one, we've hired a consultant. We're not hiring consultants.

You'll operate with unusual autonomy: you decide what's worth building, when a workaround is acceptable and when it's technical debt we'll regret, and when to tell a customer their real problem is not the one they asked about. You'll be technical enough that when something breaks in a customer environment, you find the root cause yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting.

What You'll Do

Own outcomes end to end  - discovery, modelling, implementation, performance tuni

Fiducial is a young but fast-growing deep-tech start-up with big ambitions at the frontier of autonomy, perception, and defence. Our core expertise lies in 3D vision and graphics technologies which we deploy in a dual-use context for inspection and defence. This role will focus mainly on the defence context where we are developing software for advanced on-board UAV situational awareness in military applications. Our office is located in the Aerospace Innovation Hub, a start-up hub located on the TU Delft campus in the faculty of Aerospace Engineering. Owning hardware from prototype through to a field-ready product.

Participer à l’industrialisation des usages IA

Transformer des datasets complexes en produits data exploitables

Expérimenter les nouveaux usages de l’IA appliqués à la Data

Formation & Parcours :  Titulaire d'un  Bac+5 en informatique  (Master, école d'ingénieur) ou un parcours équivalent avec une solide expérience acquise sur le terrain.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow,

Booking.com  , Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence.

Position Description

As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture.

You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction.

You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices.

Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success.

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
jobs.description:

You’ll join the

Traffic Control Features team

within TomTom’s  Automated Driving organization . The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about

traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings  .

You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy.

What you will do:

Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with

Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets.

Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output.

Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation.

Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes.

Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity.

production  .

Experience leading well-scoped technical projects and mentoring junior colleagues.

Ability to work across data, algorithms, modeling, ground truth and evaluation rather than operating within only one area of expertise.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently approach complex and ambiguous problems.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our team and help us build a production-ready AI/data product for TomTom. The work is covering everything from new feature development to infrastructure, and data Engineering.

Responsibilities:

Build AI systems: Design, develop and maintain production AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, agentic workflows and ML model services.

Productionize models: Take models and prototypes from applied scientists and turn them into robust, low-latency, cost-efficient services that scale to global traffic.

Evaluation and quality: Define and automate evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and guardrails that measure accuracy, safety, latency and cost, and monitor models once they're in production.

Data and pipelines: Build and optimize data pipelines for training, fine-tuning, embedding and inference, making sure data is high quality, traceable and handled in line with privacy requirements.

MLOps and infrastructure: Implement CI/CD for ML, model versioning, experiment tracking and observability on cloud platforms.

Cross-functional collaboration: Work with product, engineering and science stakeholders to understand requirements, weigh trade-offs and deliver AI solutions that meet customer needs.

Continuous improvement: Keep up with the fast-moving AI ecosystem, evaluate new models, tools and techniques, and share what you learn with the wider engineering community.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Strong proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages such as C++, Java, Python, or similar languages.

Hands-on experience with LLMs and their ecosystem: prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings and vector databases, tool use and agent frameworks, and fine-tuning is preferred.

Solid understanding of software architecture, API design, design patterns and best practices for maintainable, scalable systems.

Experience with cloud service providers (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD tools.

Knowledge of version control systems, preferably Git.

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team.

Experience with ML frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or Hugging Face is preferred.

Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools (e.g., MLflow, experiment tracking, model monitoring) is preferred.

Experience with geospatial, mapping or location data is a plus, but not required.

This covers GitHub platform management, artifact management with JFrog Artifactory, security scanning, developer tooling and AI governance platforms. We treat internal developers as our customers and aim to make the secure path the easy path.

What you will do

Administer and automate GitHub Enterprise: repository settings, rulesets, access and governance across a large repository estate.

Operate and improve JFrog Artifactory, including repository configuration, cleanup, permissions and support for our hybrid cloud setup.

Replace repetitive admin work with scripts and automation using Python, Bash and REST APIs.

Build and maintain GitHub Actions workflows and support teams whose pipelines pull and publish packages.

Manage platform configuration as code with Terraform or similar tools.

Use AI tools to speed up automation and support work, and help developers adopt them safely in line with our AI governance approach.

Take ownership of well-defined platform tasks from start to finish, asking for guidance when needed.

Troubleshoot developer issues across DNS, TLS, proxies and authentication.

Write and maintain documentation and runbooks that let developers help themselves.

Explain platform policies clearly and work with developers to adopt them.

What you need

2 to 5 years of experience in DevOps, platform, build or infrastructure engineering.

Git and GitHub: comfortable with branching, pull requests, reviews and repository settings; hands-on experience with GitHub Actions.

Scripting and automation: Python or Bash, with experience calling REST APIs.

CI/CD basics: you have built or maintained pipelines and understand how builds pull and publish packages.

Package ecosystems: working knowledge of at least two of Maven/Gradle, npm, PyPI, Docker and NuGet.

Linux and networking: you can find your way around a server and troubleshoot DNS, TLS, proxy and authentication problems.

Infrastructure as Code: some experience with Terraform or a similar tool, ideally for managing platform configuration.

AI in day-to-day work: good understanding of AI coding assistants and agents such as GitHub Copilot or Claude, and hands-on experience using them to write scripts, automate tasks, troubleshoot and document your work.

Nice to have

Cloud basics in Azure or AWS.

Identity basics: exposure to SSO, SAML/OIDC or SCIM.

Security awareness: secrets management, least privilege and dependency scanning; exposure to Black Duck, Coverity or Veracode is a plus.

Admin experience on a developer platform such as GitHub, GitLab, Artifactory, Nexus or Jenkins.

How you work

You write clear docs and runbooks, because platform teams depend on them.

You treat internal developers as customers and can explain a policy without creating friction.
