jobs.title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

You thrive the most when solving problems : Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.

You are a natural relationship builder : Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.

You are the architect of your own career : If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft

jobs.title: Senior Consulting Engineer
jobs.description:
RTI is seeking someone that will help support our Aerospace & Defense customers in the EMEA territory. You will be working closely with the Account Manager in the region to help drive growth of our products and services. We are looking for a team player who is self-motivated, comfortable operating without day-to-day direction and eager to work with customers as they shape the future of A&D technology. Check this blog out that details what an FAE does at RTI!

✨ What You’ll Do

Achieving Annual Sales Quota:

  • Create compelling presentations that convey RTI technology value & benefits to prospects.
  • Organize and execute detailed Proof-of-Concept engagements and build compelling software demos using RTI products.
  • Support product proposals to align with customer requirements including RFP/RFQ responses.

Achieving customer satisfaction:

  • Work closely with internal teams to coordinate resources to resolve customer's pre-sales technical blockers and to respond to RFPs.
  • Coordinate and document customer technical requirements with Product Management for continuing product evolution for EMEA market requirements.

Increasing the sales pipeline:

  • Work closely with Account management to develop sales strategies.
  • Periodically create technical articles for publication showing RTI Technology and Business value.
  • Attend tradeshows and events to give presentations and man booths to raise awareness about our product.

🎯 What We’re Looking For

  • BS or higher in technical field, MS preferred.
  • Ability to Travel (~20-40%) and on-site work is required to achieve job objectives.
  • Experience of working with Distributed Systems in a technical role (preferably in the A&D Industry).
  • Strong understanding of OS (e.g. Threading, etc) and networking concepts (E.g. UDP, Multicast, OSI Layer switching, routing, VLANs).
  • C/C++ development expertise and understanding of SDLC processes.
  • Excellent presentation skills, coupled with excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate with customers and internal stakeholders in English.
  • Experience designing a high-level technical solution/architecture based on customer requirements.
  • Experience working in a customer facing role.
  • EU Citizenship required*
    • Due to the sensitive nature of our Aerospace & Defense projects and specific client contractual obligations, this role requires the successful candidate to hold EU Citizenship to meet security clearance and data access protocols.

  • Experience in communication middlew

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION
At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes with industry leading products and platforms developed through an AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle.

ABOUT US
Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

  • One Team. One Redwood
  • Make Your Own Weather
  • Obsess over Customer Success
  • Work the Problem
  • Be Curious
  • Own the Outcome
  • Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Backend Software Developer on the RunMyJobs (RMJ) team, you will design and deliver the services that power Redwood’s enterprise automation platform. You will shape backend architecture, build secure and reliable integrations, and improve the performance and operability of systems that support mission-critical customer workflows.

jobs.title: Manager Customer Data Engineering – Change & IT Customer Services
jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan de datafundering van de Customer Services-organisatie van morgen?

Als Manager Customer Data Engineering ontwikkel je een ervaren engineeringteam door naar een strategisch Data Product Team.

Je brengt data, technologie en business samen en zorgt voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten.

Zo maak je met jouw leiderschap direct impact op besluitvorming, klantbediening én de verdere digitale ontwikkeling van Athora.

Wat je over ons moet weten?  Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en we willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?  De Manager Data Customer Engineering rapporteert aan de Director Change & IT Customer Services en geeft leiding aan een team van 10 data engineers en DevOps engineers. Het team is verantwoordelijk voor betrouwbare, herleidbare en bruikbare data voor interne 
bedrijfsvoering en sturing, operationele besluitvorming, externe verantwoordingsrapportages en toekomstige AI-toepassingen binnen het Customer Services en Commerce domein. De Manager Data Engineering is verantwoordelijk voor de doorontwikkeling van het huidige 
uitvoerende data- en rapportageteam naar een strategisch Data Product Team. De rol versterkt de data engineering capability binnen Customer Services door betrouwbare, herleidbare en AI-ready dataproducten te realiseren voor operationele sturing, besluitvorming, externe verantwoording en toekomstige data en AI-toepassingen. De manager borgt dat data een betrouwbare weergave vormt van businessprocessen en portalen, dat API's een robuuste en betrouwbare brug vormen tussen applicaties, en dat data-delivery plaatsvindt via Agile werkwijzen, schaalbare data engineering, gecontroleerde DevOps-processen en structurele datakwaliteitsborging.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

Ontwikkelen van het Data Engineering team naar een strategisch Data Product Team met  end-to-end eigenaarschap voor betrouwbare en waardevolle dataproducten;

Het doorvertalen van de Athora datastrategie binnen Customer Services, inclusief het verhogen van datamanagement maturity en het borgen van data lineage en traceerbaarheid. Hiertoe behoort ook de functionele sturing op de DQ processen, de functionele sturing richting de data stewards om de meting van en verbeteringen in de datakwaliteit vorm te geven;

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on Legal Specialist (Law Enforcement) to join our Litigation, Regulatory & Policy team at Anthropic. In this role, you will be a key player in building out our legal function and running how Anthropic responds to law enforcement and government requests for user data, while navigating the intricate regulatory landscape of the AI industry. We expect this role to flex beyond the law enforcement queue into legal operations to support the broader litigation, regulatory, and policy team. The successful candidate will be a strong team player, able to build positive relationships with colleagues and work collaboratively toward shared goals.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end response to law enforcement and government requests for user data, from intake and validation through production and closeout, including subpoenas, court orders, search warrants, preservation letters, and emergency disclosure requests from domestic and foreign authorities

  • Handle foreign and cross-border process, including MLATs and letters rogatory, and manage escalations across jurisdictions

  • Maintain expertise in where user data lives across Anthropic's product surfaces and operate the internal data retrieval tooling

  • Monitor legal developments in government access to user data and advise the team on their operational impact

  • Support litigation and regulatory matters and stretch beyond core responsibilities as needed to support the legal team's objectives

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience in a legal operations, business/operations manager, or paralegal role in an in-house legal department, or similar experience

jobs.title: AI Safety Residency - SLPreP
jobs.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs Preparedness and Policy (SLPreP), we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

The work includes thinking about various failure modes, evaluating whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Residents take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide AI safety residents on projects in AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AI systems, including monitoring their reasoning to detect harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment red-teaming: Developing science around testing whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: Examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: A benchmark with task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: evaluating whether language models choose harmful actions when given simulated dangerous tools under various operational pressures
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • RSI Control: evaluating whether frontier models can covertly sabotage R&D efforts in the RSI loop.

jobs.title: International Expansion - Germany
jobs.description:
At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.  We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.  We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.  Read more about what we’re building

here

.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the German market.

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen.  This role will assess Axle’s participation in German markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace.  You speak German and fluent English. Other European languages are also an asset.

What you will be doing

Owning Axle’s commercial results in the German market: pipeline, revenue and partner success

Winning new customers end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, and setting partners up to generate meaningful revenue

Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing, customer segmentation and launch strategy

Building the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships. You’ll be on the phone (and on the ground) with utilities/retailers, potential clients and grid operators, creating and disproving hypotheses as quickly as possible

Continuing to sharpen our view of where the value is and which markets and business models are accessible to us

Building lasting relationships with grid operators and the regulator, so that Axle is well positioned as the market evolves

Acting as the conduit between partners and engineering, creating fast, structured feedback loops that turn field insights into product improvements

As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets.  You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments.  This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification.

What’s in it for you  This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensatio

About Isembard  Isembard is building a network of high-performance factories for critical industries. We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.  The role  Own CAM programming and machining standards at our Hamburg factory, from toolpath to first article prove-out, cycle time optimisation and production handover.  You will build the programming playbook our German sites run on. You program it, you prove it out, you run it.  What you'll do

Program, simulate and optimise 3-axis and 5-axis milling toolpaths.

Set up, prove out and run jobs to aerospace and defence standards.

Choose tooling, cutting parameters and workholding for aluminium, steels, titanium and Inconel.

Build toolpath libraries, programming templates and documentation from scratch.

Train machinists on programming standards as the team grows.

What we're looking for

Strong CAM programming in Hypermill, Mastercam, Siemens NX or equivalent.

A record of holding tolerances of ±0.01 mm or tighter.

Experience setting and running high-end machines such as Hermle or DMG Mori: you can program and run the machine yourself.

A solid understanding of feeds, speeds, tooling strategy and workholding.

Confident reading of complex drawings and GD&T, with clean documentation and revision control.

Nice to have

Aerospace or defence manufacturing.

5-axis simultaneous machining.

Titanium, Inconel and high-strength alloys.

NC simulation such as Vericut.

EN 9100 or AS9100.

Why Isembard

Technical authority over programming standards across our German sites.

Work on mission-critical aerospace and defence components.

Advanced 5-axis machine tools and growing automation.

Competitive salary and equity.

We combine advanced machine tools, robotics and our own software, MasonOS, to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and frontier technology companies, with factories across the UK, US, Germany and France. Our mission is to forge industrial acceleration.  The role  Own dimensional inspection at our Hamburg factory, from CMM programming and first article inspection to non-conformance root cause and audit readiness.  You will build the metrology function rather than inherit one: inspection programmes, probing and datum strategy, gauge calibration, and how quality data flows back into machining and MasonOS. You program it, you measure it, you sign it off.  What you'll do

Program and optimise CMM inspection routines in PC-DMIS, Zeiss Calypso or equivalent for complex, tight-tolerance parts.

Run first article inspection (EN 9102), in-process inspection and final sign-off for aerospace, defence and energy work.

Set probing strategy, fixturing and datum schemes, and build inspection fixtures where needed.

Find the root cause of non-conformances and take the corrective action back to the machine with our machinists and CAM programmers.

Own calibration of all measuring equipment and keep records to EN 9100 standard, ready for customer and certification audits.

What we're looking for

Several years of hands-on CMM programming in precision manufacturing, aerospace or a machine shop.

Strong practical command of PC-DMIS and/or Zeiss Calypso.

Deep working knowledge of GD&T and ISO GPS, and confident with customer 3D CAD models.

Aerospace inspection documentation: FAI, AS9102 or EN 9102.

Able to measure and verify tolerances of ±0.01 mm and tighter.

Nice to have

Building a quality function from scratch, or taking a site through EN 9100 or AS9100.

GD&T certification or a quality management qualification.

In-process probing on 5-axis machines with closed-loop correction.

SPC and process capability analysis.

Some English, for working with our UK and US teams.

Why Isembard

Own the quality function of a new factory from day one.

Work on mission-critical aerospace and defence components.

Set inspection standards that our network will use.

Competitive salary and equity.

Location: On-site at our Hamburg factory.  Applications in German or English are welcome.  Lieber auf Deutsch? Hier bewerben.

Strong practical knowledge of several core technology and security domains, such as Network Security, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations or IT Resilience.

Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets.

Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management.

Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery.

Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale.

Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network.

Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team.

Commercial instinct first, engineering second.

Full-time in Rotterdam

. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening.

jobs.description:
About the Role  We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.  First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out  how  we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.  You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

First 3 months:  Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

Within 6 months:  Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

After 1 year:  Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

Own the full sales cycle, independently:  Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time):  Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

Drive expansion:  Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

Sell on value:  Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

Manage deals with discipline:  Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

Test and build, alongside selling:  Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the DACH market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

Early-stage DNA:  You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

About L1VE 
L1VE is a growing media and technology company with offices in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K/3D/360° streaming technology and innovative live formats, we are changing the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role

You are the voice of L1VE online. You build our social media from the ground up, take full ownership of it and work closely with our Content & Experience team. You report to the Head of Marketing & Sales. As the function grows, you can build your own team.

Full-time (5 days/week), project-based, 12 months

Work remotely within Europe or Asia, or on-site in Berlin

What You'll Do

Own all L1VE social media channels (Reddit, TikTok, Instagram, X; YouTube optional), incl. strategy, tone of voice and content calendar

Build and lead our own subreddit, our main place for talking with the community

Create platform-native short-form video (TikTok, Reels) that shows what it feels like to be there live with a VR headset, incl. ideas, scripts, editing and trend monitoring

Create content hands-on together with our content team

Manage community engagement across all channels, fast and in the L1VE voice

Create real-time content around our live events, optionally on site

Brief and manage freelancers, agencies, creators and on-site event partners, incl. quality control

Report on reach, engagement, follower growth and traffic, and feed learnings straight into the next content

Attend selected live events, including occasional international trips

Your profile

Must-have

3–5 years of social media management experience for a brand, publisher, sports club, league or agency

A portfolio of your own posts, videos or campaigns with proven results

Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram: formats, algorithms, trends and internet culture

Hands-on short-form video skills: concept, shooting and editing (e.g. CapCut, Premiere)

Excellent written and spoken English (at least C1), German is a plus

Strong sense of ownership and a hands-on mentality: you build things from scratch and see them through

Nice-to-have

Experience working with freelancers or agencies

Practical experience with AI tools, ideally with concrete use cases

Data-driven approach using platform analytics

Experience with Reddit and its communities

Interest in sports, entertainment and immersive technology

jobs.title: 3D & LiDAR Data Annotation Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re building high-quality ground-truth datasets used to train and validate perception models for autonomous and operator-assisted machines working in complex, real-world environments.

As a Data Annotation Analyst, you’ll work with camera imagery, video, and LiDAR point clouds to create precise labels that help perception systems understand objects, people, terrain, and surrounding environments. You’ll work in specialized annotation tools, following detailed specifications while balancing accuracy, consistency, and production volume.

Your Impact

Annotate 2D and 3D objects across images, video, and LiDAR point clouds, including vehicles, machinery, people, signage, and environmental features.

Create and maintain accurate segmentation, object tracking, pose, and keypoint annotations across sequences.

Apply detailed annotation guidelines, including class definitions, occlusion rules, object thresholds, and inclusion/exclusion criteria.

Review your work, respond to QA feedback, and maintain established quality and accuracy standards.

Identify and escalate ambiguous scenes, sensor artifacts, tooling issues, and gaps in specifications rather than making assumptions.

Document data quality and tooling issues with clear details and reproduction steps.

Participate in calibration sessions, guideline reviews, and team standups to maintain consistent interpretations.

Share observations that help improve annotation guidelines, taxonomies, and edge-case documentation.

Success in this role means producing accurate, consistent annotations at the expected volume while helping maintain a reliable, high-quality dataset.

What You Bring

Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accuracy while performing repetitive, visually intensive work for extended periods.

Strong spatial reasoning skills, including the ability to interpret 3D environments and understand object size, position, and orientation.

Ability to learn and navigate complex, purpose-built software and become productive with keyboard shortcuts and other tooling features.

Experience working in a fast-paced, scaled environment with defined productivity, quality, or accuracy targets.

Experience with image annotation GenAI workflows

Reliable high-speed internet, a distraction-free workspace, and the ability to work on a company-provisioned machine within a controlled environment.

Nice to Haves

Associate or bachelor’s degree.

Experience with image, video, LiDAR, or 3D annotation tools.

Experience with subsurface utility engineering (SUE), construction surveying, surveying, GIS, or other work involving spatial interpretation of physical environments.

Experience with AutoCAD or similar type tools

Experience in construction, mining, agriculture, industrial operations, or heavy equipment environments.

Familiarity with point cloud data, sensor fusion, or camera-LiDAR calibration.

Experience working with autonomous vehicles, robotics, or machine perception datasets

jobs.title: AI Transformation Manager (gn)
jobs.description:
Dein nächster Schritt: KI-Transformation selbst umsetzen, mit direktem Draht zum CTO

Arbeitsort:  Metropolregion Rhein-Ruhr, hybrid. Du bist regelmäßig vor Ort im Team, aber nicht jeden Tag. Der Reiseanteil liegt bei rund 5 bis 10 Prozent.  ​

Das Unternehmen

Unser Kunde ist eine etablierte, europäisch aufgestellte Dienstleistungsgruppe mit Landesgesellschaften in einem guten Dutzend Ländern, mehr als 10.000 Beschäftigten und über einer halben Milliarde Euro Umsatz. Das Geschäft lebt von Daten, Prozessen und schnellen Entscheidungen, also genau dort, wo KI den größten Hebel hat. Deshalb baut sich die Gruppe gerade von Grund auf neu: kein Pilot in einer Abteilung, sondern ein Umbau von Organisation, Produkt und Arbeitsweise über alle Länder hinweg. Das große Transformationsprogramm startet jetzt, und du bist von Anfang an dabei. Dahinter stehen ein neu aufgestelltes Leadership-Team, ein CTO, der selbst aus der Top-Beratung kommt, und ein langfristig denkender Eigentümer. Ein eigenes Plattformteam entwickelt bereits die KI-Anwendung und erste Agenten, und mit dem neuen Innovation Hub bekommt die Transformation ihren eigenen Ort.  Große Programme leben davon, dass aus einer klugen Idee ein belastbares Konzept wird und daraus eine Entscheidung. Für genau diese Arbeit in der Tiefe entsteht direkt beim CTO eine neue Rolle.  ​

Deine Aufgaben

Du berichtest direkt an den CTO und verantwortest eigene strategische Arbeitspakete. Der Chief of Staff behält das Gesamtbild, du gehst in die Tiefe.

Du übernimmst klar abgegrenzte Teile der großen KI- und Technologievorhaben und hältst Fortschritt und Risiken nach.

Du erarbeitest, nach welchen Methoden und Standards die Organisation künftig mit KI arbeitet.

Du arbeitest an neuen Modellen für KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung und bringst sie in die Breite.

Du rechnest Alternativen durch und machst daraus Vorlagen, auf deren Basis der Vorstand entscheiden kann.

Du gestaltest Workshops und Führungsrunden und sorgst dafür, dass Beschlüsse auch umgesetzt werden.

Du bist im engen Austausch mit Produktteams, Fachbereichen und Landesgesellschaften.

​

Dein Profil

Du bringst rund 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit, in denen du Themen analysiert und vorangebracht hast, etwa im Inhouse Consulting, in einem Strategie- oder Transformationsstab, im Tech-Bereich eines Unternehmens oder in der Beratung.

Du hast generative KI, Agenten oder Automatisierung selbst praktisch eingesetzt und kannst Beispiele zeigen.

Du verstehst, wie Applikationen, Architekturen und moderne Softwareentwicklung zusammenspielen.

Du bist sicher in Business Cases, Datenanalyse und Entscheidungsvorlagen.

Du arbeitest eigenständig und findest dich schnell in neue Themen ein.

Du kommunizierst auf Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher.

Zur Einordnung:  Wir suchen Berufserfahrene, die selbst anpacken. Programmleitung oder Führung sind hier die Perspektive, nicht die Voraussetzung.  ​

jobs.title: AI Security Researcher
jobs.description:
About the Role

As an AI Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in AI/ML security, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with AI workloads, large language models, training frameworks, advanced optimization algorithms, GPU clusters, and ideally SLURM in HPC environments. You excel at modeling AI threats—model/data poisoning, permission escalation, backdoors, data drift attacks, prompt injection—and translating them into practical security defenses.

You will be one of Haste's first AI security researchers pioneering defenses for trillion-parameter AI training environments alongside HPC and quantum workloads.

Key Responsibilities

Adversarial Threat Research:  Investigating emerging attack vectors and developing techniques to uncover vulnerabilities in AI models, data pipelines, and infrastructure.

Threat Modeling & Risk Analysis:  Mapping and characterizing potential threats across the AI lifecycle—from data ingestion to deployment—to prioritize security investments.

Developing Defenses & Guardrails:  Designing and implementing detection logic and researching mitigation methods to AI threats.

Collaborating with Engineering Teams:  Translating research findings into actionable, production-grade security requirements for product teams, ensuring threat detection makes sense.

Documentation & Reporting:  Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization or to the public.

Monitoring AI Ecosystem Trends:  Staying updated on the latest AI security standards, frameworks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, MITRE ATLAS), and academic research.

Requirements

University degree in AI/ML or relevant discipline.  Current residence in Germany or Austria.  Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only.

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.

Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Enterprise Account Executive

As an Account Executive at Quince, you will be responsible for developing, managing, and growing a portfolio of enterprise merchandise clients across industries including Finance, Legal, Sports, Media, and Entertainment. This role requires a proactive and strategic approach to business development, relationship management, and ability to operate in a fast-paced dynamic start up environment. jobs.title: (Senior) Product Manager - Customer Taxation (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t. We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require.

Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind.


Your Responsibilities

  • You will own a regulated domain that customers depend on every tax year. Working with an experienced Engineering Lead, you will become the go-to expert for customer taxation at Raisin.
  • Own customer taxation end to end: Define the vision and roadmap together with Product and Engineering leadership. Take each topic from discovery to delivery to measured impact. Decide what we build first, and keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, risks and trade-offs.
  • Keep tax accurate and reliable: Agree with Legal, Compliance and country managers on what correct looks like. Work with Engineering so calculation, documents and reporting

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhDs, postdoctoral researchers, and professors with domain expertise in STEM fields such as Computer Science, Machine Learning, Physics, Biology, Chemistry, Mathematics, Humanities, or other related disciplines.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion in applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows.
  • Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channel

jobs.title: Product Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
Location:  Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone  Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.  At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.  I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.  Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.  That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You'll ship every week and lead the team's biggest technical work — and as the team grows, you'll grow into managing it.  You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.  — Grigory

Why Secfix exists  Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.  Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.  We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.  This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.

Month 1: Ship.  Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feat

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

As a Web Design Manager at Anthropic, you will lead the enterprise web design team responsible for how businesses experience Anthropic on the web. Our website is often the first place enterprise buyers encounter Claude, and the pages your team ships need to make complex, technical products feel clear, distinctive, and trustworthy. The NetEase group encompasses a range of innovative businesses centered around content creation, including:

  • NetEase Games, one of the largest and most renowned game developers worldwide by size, revenue and game offerings. Over the years, NetEase Games has focused on developing high quality content and providing the best experience for gamers around the world;

  • Yanxuan, NetEase’s private label consumer lifestyle brand; and
  • Other innovative businesses, including, among others, an online payment platform and to-B technology solutions.

We are seeking a junior to mid-level legal counsel to join our in-house legal team supporting the public company compliance work of NetEase, Inc. which is dual-listed on Nasdaq and The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (HKEX), with additional subsidiaries separately listed in Hong Kong or the U.S.

You will take hands-on responsibility for the day-to-day securities filings, periodic reporting, and ongoing listing compliance and corporate governance obligations of the parent company and its listed subsidiaries.

This is an excellent opportunity for a securities/capital markets lawyer to develop expertise across two major regulatory regimes within a multi-listed corporate structure, while also gaining valuable insight into a fascinating and fast-evolving industry. You will collaborate closely with our finance, treasury, transactions and IR departments and other legal team members.

Location

Ongoing Disclosure & Regulatory Filings

jobs.title: Lead Animation Technical Artist
jobs.description:
Job Description

  1. Responsible for the technical R&D and quality breakthroughs of the runtime animation system for the dual-perspective shooting game, systematically improving character movement, aiming, weapon handling, combat states, and the overall shooting experience.
  2. Personally design, validate, and implement core solutions for aiming and weapon handling experience, procedural animation, animation graphs, and state orchestration. Identify and resolve animation quality issues across assets, engine, gameplay, and runtime from both first-person and third-person perspectives.
  3. Hold decision-making authority for the project’s animation technical approach. Establish animation technical specifications, review standards, problem-diagnosis methods, and effect acceptance mechanisms. Drive stable mass production and continuous iteration of solutions within the project.
  4. Collaborate with animation, programming, and game design teams to translate animation technical solutions into executable development plans and advance cross-team implementation.
  5. Lead and mentor the animation TA team through matrix management, with authority to set team technical standards. Responsible for technical direction, coaching on complex issues, capability building, and experience accumulation, while enhancing the team’s ability to independently tackle difficult problems with project delivery as a priority.

Job Requirements

  1. Many years of experience in game animation and animation TA R&D, having worked on top-tier high-quality realistic PvP shooter products. Experience in runtime animation development for Call of Duty PvP or equivalent-level shooting projects is preferred.
  2. Deep understanding of the feel and runtime performance of dual-perspective shooting games. Ability to independently take ownership of the design, R&D, and closed-loop delivery of one or more core systems, such as aiming and weapon handling, procedural animation, animation graphs, and state orchestration.
  3. Complete game development pipeline experience. Ability to independently drive targeted quality breakthroughs in runtime animation — from problem identification and technical validation to cross-team execution and live-operation effect evaluation.

jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior or Lead Gameplay Animator with strong AAA FPS experience to help shape responsive, compelling character movement and moment-to-moment gameplay.
With a focus on Character, Controls, and Camera (3C), you will combine animation craft with practical implementation skills to develop features from early prototypes through final in-game polish. Working closely with gameplay designers, programmers, and technical animators, you will help ensure that character animation, player input, and camera behavior work together to deliver a cohesive player experience.
This is a hands-on role with meaningful ownership of gameplay animation features and opportunities to influence the systems and workflows behind them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own gameplay animation features from concept to completion, including reference gathering, prototyping, asset creation, engine integration, debugging, and polish.
  • Create high-quality character movement and action animations, covering locomotion, directional changes, stance transitions, traversal, and combat interactions.
  • Contribute to first-person animation and its relationship with full-body movement, weapon handling, and camera feedback.
  • Partner with designers and programmers to refine movement responsiveness, action timing, transitions, and interruption behavior while preserving believable weight and physicality.
  • Build and refine animation graphs, state machines, blend setups, and animation layers within the project’s engine and tools.
  • Use keyframe animation and motion-capture workflows to deliver animation that meets gameplay and visual requirements.
  • Evaluate your work in playable builds, identify the causes of animation issues, and collaborate across disciplines to resolve them.
  • Work with technical animation and engineering teams to improve workflows and address runtime, asset, and production constraints.
  • For Lead-level appointments, guide feature planning, establish animation quality benchmarks, provide actionable feedback, and mentor teammates while continuing to create and implement animation directly.

What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience creating and implementing gameplay animation for AAA first-person shooters, with clear ownership of features or animation systems.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating body mechanics, weight, timing, posing, and a clear understanding of responsive gameplay animation.
  • Practical experience taking animation assets into a game engine and iterating on their behavior in playable builds.
  • Working knowledge of animation graphs, state machines, blending, additive animation, and gameplay-driven transitions.
  • An understanding of how character movement, player controls, and camera behavior influence each other and shape game feel.

We are looking for a Game Category Operations Executive to own and grow an assigned game category on our overseas game trading platform. Job Description

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.

We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.

You Will:

  • Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
  • Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
  • Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
  • Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.

You Have:

  • Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
  • Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
  • Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D

We’re looking for an outstanding Software Engineer to join our Game Engine Data Model team. As a member of this team, you will innovate on the core data structures that form the backbone of Roblox’s platform. In this role you will have first hand opportunity to design and build one of the core technologies that makes the Roblox game engine special.

The Data Model is the object hierarchy that is analogous to a scene graph or entity system, powering all our experiences by exposing an interface between core engine capabilities and our creators. It also acts as a fabric to core technologies, such as networking, scripting, Studio, rendering and physics which are essential to the high performance of the Roblox game engine.

You Will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Work cross-functionally with other teams to deliver high-quality functionality.
  • Improve product quality by writing automated tests for your code.
  • Take ownership of features and projects, from design through launch.
  • Build and test code that runs across supported devices, including desktop, mobile, and console.

You Have:

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code.   • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale systems that directly shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

The Agent Infra team builds the infrastructure that runs autonomous AI agents at Roblox for millions of creators building experiences on our platform, and for thousands of Roblox engineers shipping production code every day.

Agent workloads break the assumptions most infrastructure is built on. They run for hours instead of milliseconds, they’re non-deterministic, they execute code nobody wrote, and they need real credentials against real systems to be useful at all. Making that safe, durable, and cost-effective at Roblox’s scale is the hard problem our team is solving.

What You’ll Do:

Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.

We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. jobs.title: Research Scientist, AI Safety and Alignment
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY
jobs.description:
Scale Labs, Research Scientist — AI Safety and Alignment

As the leading data and evaluation partner for frontier AI companies, Scale plays a central role in understanding and safeguarding AI systems. Building on this expertise, Scale Labs has launched a new team focused on technical AI safety and policy research, to bridge the gap between frontier AI research and policy, helping policymakers make informed, evidence-based decisions about AI capabilities and risks.

Our research tackles some of the hardest open problems in AI safety: assessing the alignment of frontier models, developing control protocols and monitoring methods, preserving the monitorability, understanding failure modes in multi-agent systems and recursive self-improvement. We collaborate closely with partners across industry, the public sector, and academia and regularly publish our findings. We are looking for talented researchers to join us in shaping this vision.

As a Research Scientist on this team, you will conduct research and build evaluations, tools, and datasets that help us understand and reduce risks from frontier AI systems. For example, you might do any or all of the following:

  • Design and stress-test control protocols and monitoring systems that detect and limit unsafe behavior by AI models and agents in deployment;
  • Build alignment evaluations that probe for deception, sabotage, scheming, reward hacking, and other misaligned behaviors;
  • Study monitorability, including whether a model’s reasoning stays faithful and legible enough to supervise, and how training methods and deployment practices can preserve or erode it;
  • Investigate risks that emerge when multiple AI agents interact, such as collusion, coordination failures and steerability;
  • Develop threat models and evaluations for AI systems that automate AI research and development, to track progress toward recursive self-improvement and inform preparedness planning;
  • Work with government agencies and other labs to scope and design evaluations that measure and mitigate risks from advanced AI;
  • Publish research and evaluation methodologies, and write technical reports for policymakers.

Ideally you’d have:

  • Commitment to our mission of promoting safe, secure, and trustworthy AI as capabilities continue to advance.
  • Practical experience conducting technical research collaboratively. You should be comfortable building and instrumenting ML pipelines, building evaluation harnesses, running experiments on frontier models and agents, and quickly turning new ideas from the research literature into working prototypes.
  • Familiarity with current research in at least one of the areas above.
  • A track record of published research in machine learning, particularly in AI safety and alignment.
  • At least three year

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Security Risk team is responsible for how Anthropic identifies, prioritizes, and drives treatment of its most important security risks. We are rebuilding risk management to operate as an engineering function, using automation, quantitative risk and AI-native platforms to enable decision making. The risks we assess span Anthropic's full security landscape, so the team needs breadth across domains and the judgment to go deep wherever a decision demands it. Security Risk, in deep partnership with Security Engineering, helps define the security program and shapes how investment and treatment decisions get made.

The conventional GRC playbook was not built for a company shipping frontier AI. You will help define what replaces it, with a direct line to CISO-level decisions. As a Security Risk Analyst you will take risk questions from leadership and partner teams and drive them to a decision. Sometimes that is a fast, structured qualitative assessment and other times it is a deep FAIR-based quantitative analysis. Either way you bring leadership a clear position, the tradeoffs, and honest uncertainty, and you defend it under challenge. In parallel, you will help turn quantitative risk into a product partner teams can leverage, and define the standards a growing risk function will run on.

Key responsibilities

  • Enable leadership and partner teams to make risk-informed decisions. Take ambiguous risk questions, drive them to a documented decision, and communicate the quantitative and qualitative tradeoffs clearly

  • Lead quantitative analysis of the company's top security risk scenarios using FAIR, calibrated estimation, and simulation, working with the engineers who own the systems and presenting results in terms leadership can act on

  • Partner with Security Engineering to assess threat scenarios and control effectiveness so security investment is right-sized to actual risk and remediation is sequenced where it buys down the most risk

  • Frame escalations and risk treatment decisions with a clear recommendation, an honest statement of uncertainty, and re-evaluation triggers, and pressure test those decisions with risk owners

  • Shape the analysis and narrative behind leadership risk reviews, and help define risk appetite and the risk metrics the organization should measure and why

  • Use AI and automation to scale risk analysis, and own the calibration and quality review that keep the outputs

Forward-deployed means  aligned with the mission hero , not  always on a plane . Most of the work is remote.   • 전사 운영체계 및 거버넌스 설계/개선: 조직 간 역할·책임(R&R) 정립, 자원배분 최적화, 업무 프로세스 및 제도 설계·운영·모니터링
  • 전사 전략 프로젝트 수행: 경영진 수명 전사 전략과제 기획 및 실행, 크로스펑셔널 협업 조율
  • 팀 운영 및 성과 관리: 목표 설정 및 기대치 수립, 업무 배분 및 리소스 조율, 프로젝트 진척 모니터링, 팀 성과 관리 및 결과 도출

  • 전사 또는 그룹 차원의 사업계획 및 성과관리 사이클을 운영해본 경험이 있는 분
  • 전사 운영 프로세스 및 제도 설계, 조직 간 R&R 정립 경험이 있는 분
  • Business Fluent 이상의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량
  • 게임·미디어·엔터테인먼트 산업에 대한 직·간접 경험 및 이해도

  • 서류 전형 > 전화 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > 1차/2차 실무 면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 최종 면접 (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사

예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • AI Product Dev Chapter는 소속 엔지니어들의 기술 역량과 성장을 책임지는 조직입니다. 각 스쿼드의 PO가 제품과 사업을 이끌고, 챕터는 기술 방향·개발 품질·공통 기반·인재 육성을 맡습니다. 스쿼드가 개발·운영하는 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. 챕터의 목표는 스쿼드의 AI 기술이 고객 가치와 매출로 이어지는 속도를 높이는 것입니다.
  • 스쿼드가 만드는 AI 제품 중 일부는 실제 고객에게 출시해 운영하는 단계에 들어서고 있습니다. 고객 요구에 맞는 기능을 적시에 출시하려면 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 정하고, 제품 품질과 운영 비용을 고려해 기술적 병목을 해결해야 합니다. 챕터는 PO와 함께 이 과정을 이끌고, 여러 스쿼드에서 얻은 경험을 본부 공통의 개발 역량으로 발전시켜 갑니다.
  • 이번에 합류하실 분은 챕터장으로서 제품별 기술 의사결정과 공통 개발·검증 체계를 이끌고, 엔지니어를 채용·육성하며 챕터의 일하는 방식을 만들어 갑니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 제품 기술 의사결정: PO와 함께 고객 요구를 기술 과제로 구체화하고, 사업 우선순위에 맞춰 개발 범위와 일정을 조율합니다. 스쿼드별 기술 스택이 파편화되지 않도록 각 제품의 아키텍처와 주요 기술은 챕터에서 결정합니다. PoC가 프로덕션 전환까지 이어지도록 중요한 기술 병목은 직접 설계 검토와 프로토타이핑에 참여해 해결합니다.
  • AI 기술 PoC와 품질 검증: 새로운 모델·API를 빠르게 비교 평가할 수 있는 PoC 환경을 만들고, AI 기능을 실제 사용 시나리오와 데이터로 평가합니다. 실패 사례와 변경 전후의 품질·응답 속도·비용을 비교해 제품 개선으로 연결합니다. 평가는 고객이 비용을 내고 쓸 품질인지까지 확인하고, 결과는 PO가 사업 판단에 쓸 수 있게 정리합니다.
  • AI 기반 개발 생산성: AI 코딩 도구가 코드베이스와 제품의 맥락, 개발 규칙을 이해하고 테스트 작성·배포 설정 같은 반복 작업을 맡을 수 있도록 개발 환경을 갖춥니다. AI가 만든 코드와 설계를 사람이 판단할 리뷰 기준을 세우고, 테스트 자동화로 빠르게 검증할 수 있게 합니다. 새로운 AI 개발 도구는 생산성·품질·보안 기준으로 평가해 도입하고, 구성원이 찾은 좋은 방법은 가이드와 세미나로 스쿼드 전체에 퍼뜨립니다.

Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • AI Frontier 본부는 크래프톤이 보유한 AI 기술과 선행 R&D 자산을 기반으로 새로운 제품과 사업을 만드는 조직입니다. AI Model과 Agent의 가능성을 실제 고객의 문제와 연결하며, 게임과 비게임 영역에서 끊임없이 0→1을 시도합니다.
  • 우리는 아직 가능성이 분명하지 않은 영역에서도 작은 기회를 발견하고, 고객과 파트너, 기술과 자원을 연결해 지속 가능한 사업으로 성장할 조건을 만들어갑니다.
  • AI Business Development는 이 과정에서 사업의 동력을 만드는 역할입니다. 제품이 완성되기 전부터 고객과 대화하며 수요를 검증하고, 파트너십과 사업모델을 설계해 실제 계약과 매출로 연결합니다. Product Owner와 함께 사업 전체를 바라보며, 새로운 사업이 실행되고 성장하는 데 필요한 기회를 만들어갈 분을 찾습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 신규 사업 기회 발굴 및 GTM 실행
    • AI 기술·R&D 자산과 고객의 문제를 연결해 사업 가설을 수립하고, 초기 시장 진입부터 사업화까지 추진합니다.
  • 초기 고객 개발 및 수요 검증
    • 제품 기획 단계부터 잠재 고객에게 직접 접근해 실제 과제와 도입 조건을 파악하고, 공동 개발·PoC·구매 등 구체적인 참여를 이끌어냅니다.
  • 전략적 파트너십 및 사업 기반 확보
    • 사업에 필요한 고객 접점, 기술, 데이터, 유통 역량을 가진 파트너를 발굴하고, 상호 이해관계를 반영한 협력 구조를 설계·실행합니다.
  • 사업모델 설계 및 매출 계약 리드
    • 고객 가치와 제공 비용을 바탕으로 사업모델과 가격 정책을 설계하고, 제안·협상·계약부터 후속 사업 확장까지 주도합니다.
  • PO와 함께 사업화 실행
    • 고객 요구와 사업 조건을 제품 범위·우선순위·일정에 연결하고, PO 및 개발·연구 조직과 함께 출시·고객 도입·운영을 추진합니다.
  • 사업 추진의 장애물 해결
    • 기술·데이터·보안·법무 등 주요 제약에 대한 대안을 마련하고, 내외부 이해관계자의 의사결정과 필요한 자원을 확보해 사업을 전진시킵니다.

  • 사업 전략 또는 사업개발을 주도해 실질적인 성과를 내고, 조직 성장을 리딩한 경험이 있으신 분

jobs.title: Head of Compliance
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.  We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.  In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.  You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

Strong judgment

jobs.title: Illustration Artist - Riftbound
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As an Illustration Artist at Riot, you will play an important role in delivering high-quality card illustrations for Riftbound. Working closely with the Art Director, Senior Illustration Artist, and cross-disciplinary partners, you will help guide card art from concept through final, print-ready delivery.

You will review artwork, provide clear and actionable feedback, and create paintovers to help external artists strengthen composition, color, storytelling, and overall execution. Drawing on a strong understanding of illustration fundamentals and visual storytelling, you will help maintain Riftbound’s quality bar and contribute to creating memorable imagery within the League of Legends universe.

Working within the constraints of physical trading card production, you will apply your knowledge of print processes, color management, and readability to help ensure artwork reproduces beautifully and consistently. You will collaborate with designers and visual designers to ensure illustrations support gameplay needs and work well with frames, typography, and other graphic elements. Reporting to the game’s Art Director, you will work within established creative direction and art briefs while partnering with external artists and internal teams to deliver polished, compelling card art.

Responsibilities:

  • Support outsourcing processes by helping review incoming artwork, communicate feedback, track revisions, and provide external artists with the visual direction and resources needed to deliver quality work.

Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™

Location
This is a fully remote opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.

Who We Are
Become part of the team behind Attribute™. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.

DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.

The Opportunity
As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for Attribute™, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.

Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)
