jobs.title: Design Director, World Systems
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a talented Design Director, World Systems to join our team on an exciting unannounced title built on a globally recognized IP in our Culver City hub, or remotely within the US.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day — whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

As Design Director, World Systems, you will own the design of procedural world generation — the systems and craft that combine terrain, creatures, props, resources, buildings, encounters, and points of interest into a cohesive, playable world. You will be hands-on from day one, partner closely with Tools to build the frameworks and tuning levers the team needs, and grow your team over time to serve the needs of the project.

What you will do:

  • Own the player experience of generated worlds and raise it to a standard that feels authored, readable, and worth exploring.
  • Define how diverse world elements (terrain, creatures, props, resources, buildings, encounters, POIs) compose into a cohesive whole rather than a pile of systems.
  • Establish and enforce world-design standards for density, gameplay pacing, traversal distances, sightlines, landmarking, and encounter/POI placement.
  • Partner with the Tools team to specify generation frameworks, authoring workflows, and the levers designers use to tune procedural output.
  • Work end-to-end in an iterative process — from earliest world concepts and prototypes through directing designers in implementation and live iteration.
  • Bring a strong level-design sensibility to procedural space: how far players walk, what they see, when the world breathes, and when it demands attention.
  • Follow a design-thinking methodology to understand player needs, ideate, and propose solutions that meet both player and business goals.
  • Understand our audience at a deep, empathetic level, and formulate world solutions that serve different player segments.
  • Closely partner with Creative Director, UX Director, Director of Product, Technical Director, and Content / Adventure leadership so world systems land cleanly in the full player experience.
  • Envision and direct world-generation designs that can sustain a large live-operated game, with scalable quality and a scalable content pipeline.
  • Understand game engine and performance boundaries, and propose creative solutions that work within them.
  • Partner with Art, UX, Tools, and Engineering to prototype specific world behaviors early — so the team can feel density, pacing, and composition before full production.
  • Manage the design of multiple wo

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (Applied Modeling) - League of Legends
jobs.description:
At Riot, we are investing in League of Legends to grow the game for generations to come. As player needs become more varied and our experiences become more dynamic, machine learning is an increasingly important part of how we help players discover the right experiences, make better decisions in and around the game, and find fair, compelling matches.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in League of Legends, you will build applied machine learning systems that directly improve player experience. You will work across player and product problems through data, modeling, experimentation, launch, and iteration, partnering closely with League product, design, Insights, game engineering, and service engineering teams. Your work could span across personalized player experiences, in-game systems, and matchmaking.

You will report to the Data Engineering Director in League of Legends and operate as a deeply embedded technical partner to the game team. You will also help strengthen craft standards, knowledge sharing, and technical quality across Riot’s growing ML engineering discipline.

Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end ML solutions for player-facing problems across personalization, game systems, and matchmaking, from problem framing through production launch and ongoing iteration.
  • Set technical direction for a League ML domain and create reusable modeling, evaluation, and operating patterns that raise the bar beyond your immediate team.
  • Build models, recommenders, ranking systems, and decision logic that help players discover the right champions, builds, modes, content, and return paths based on their needs and context.
  • Develop ML approaches that improve in-game systems and matchmaking quality, balancing player experience, fairness, reliability, and operational constraints.
  • Partner closely with product managers, designers, analysts, and engineers to shape ambiguous opportunities into clear technical plans and shipped player-facing features.
  • Translate gameplay, behavioral, and product telemetry into reliable signals and evaluation frameworks.
  • Design and run experiments to evaluate model quality, player impact, and system tradeoffs.
  • Work directly with game and service engineers to integrate models into League systems and services, including helping define instrumentation and telemetry when needed.
  • Operate independently across multiple partner groups, driving multi-month work with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Contribute to the ML engineering community at Riot through peer reviews, documentation, craft standards, and shared learnings.
  • Help establish robust monitoring, observability, and support practices for live ML systems as they scale.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent p

jobs.title: Game Producer - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot’s mission is to put players at the center of everything we do. We do this by continuing to create, evolve and deliver new experiences to players with games like Teamfight Tactics, Legends of Runeterra, VALORANT, and League of Legends.

Game Producers lead teams, initiatives and products from conception through launch and operation inside of the gaming space. They create and align teams to product vision, have a deep understanding of player needs, competitors and market conditions, and are able to balance scope, quality and time to predictably deliver at a high quality bar for players.

As a Producer II on an Unpublished R&D Product, you will be responsible for driving production efforts on a features team, supporting the development of player-facing systems. You will provide guidance and mentorship to less experienced producers. You will keep the players' experience, as well as the experience of dev teams within Riot, in mind as you track progress, deliver products/features, and organize priorities and goals. You will work within a cross functional team of engineers, designers and artists to support the team in delivering engaging experiences to our players. Your group will consist of Rioters across the globe, including Sydney and North America. You will report to a Senior Manager of Production supporting the R&D Game Teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the day-to-day production efforts for a cross-functional development team
  • Drive sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and milestone execution
  • Ensure strong team health, culture, and efficiency
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and align on goals
  • Track progress, manage risks, and ensure delivery of high-quality tools and features
  • Promote best practices in planning, estimation, and documentation
  • Coordinate across teams to unblock dependencies and align technical solutions
  • Communicate clearly and consistently with partners in multiple time zones
  • Identify opportunities to improve developer workflows and system scalability

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Producer, Project Manager or similar role in game development.
  • Ample experience working with cross-functional and distributed teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience leading teams through all feature development phases (planning, execution, delivery, post-release support).
  • Experience applying Agile and Lean development processes such as Scrum or Kanban.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience with the video game industry, in either live or multiplayer games. A background in digital project management/Agile project management/Scrum Master in a technology setting will also be considered.
  • Experience working with teams building metagames or core gameplay systems.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.location: US - Culver City, California, United States
jobs.description:
Scopely is seeking a Senior Finance Analyst to join the team behind MONOPOLY GO! This role will be located in Culver City, CA on a hybrid basis.

In this role, you will own the game’s recurring operational finance activities while building the tools and automation that make our work faster, more accurate, and more scalable. MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

You will lead operating expense month-end close, accruals, headcount tracking, purchase orders, Workday approvals, and T&E visibility. This is a build-oriented role with a clear mandate to improve how the work gets done—not simply execute existing processes. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities to apply AI and automation thoughtfully and effectively.

Over time, this role will help advance an AI-native approach to FP&A, connecting close, planning, reporting, and approvals so routine work can run more efficiently and the team can focus on higher-value judgment. This is a greenfield opportunity with significant autonomy and a dedicated budget for tools and experimentation.

You will also serve as the primary Finance business partner to our Engineering organization, acting as its main point of contact for spending, headcount, and planning. You will work closely with Finance Managers, the VP of Finance for MONOPOLY GO!, and cross-functional partners across the business, with strong senior-level support as you ramp into the role.

Why this role stands out

  • A build mandate. You own the FP&A automation stack — greenfield, with autonomy and a tool budget. A real part of the job is making the work better, not only keeping it running.
  • Scale and visibility. MONOPOLY GO! is a large, fast-growing business. Your work informs game leadership directly, with regular exposure to the VP of Finance.
  • Room to grow. A path into complex modeling, financial storytelling, and broader scope across Scopely's portfolio, with mentorship to get there.
  • A strong team. You'll join a high-caliber group with backgrounds across high-growth tech, consulting, banking, and private equity.

What you'll do

The split is honest: expect the operational cadence to be a meaningful part of your week, and the build work to grow as you automate more of it.

  • Run the OpEx close cadence. Month-end close, accruals, reclasses, and headcount reconciliation, plus high-volume PO/Workday approvals and T&E — accurately, on time, and independently before long.
  • Build the automation. Replace manual reporting with automated workflows and dashboards, and apply AI where it genuinely helps across close, planning, reporting, and appro

jobs.title: Director, Art Direction - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Art Directors at Riot drive the quality and performance of their team, establishing direction and goals that provide clarity and focus. Your scope of responsibilities include leading with vision, strategic partnership across the game, a deep understanding of audience resonance, overall team culture and performance, growth of your direct reports, and directing your team on successful execution of your vision and strategy.

As an Art Director an unpublished R&D product, you will help bring the game’s visual direction to life in a new game for players around the world. You will translate our creative direction into a distinctive, emotionally compelling, production-ready visual identity that supports gameplay, strengthens character appeal, and meets the craft bar players expect from Riot. You will partner closely with Creative Direction, Game Leadership, cross-disciplinary teams, and external partners to translate the game’s visual ambition into a cohesive, art direction.

Responsibilities:

  • Steward the game’s visual identity from concept through production
  • Translate creative direction into clear visual standards, production practices, and scalable art workflows
  • Drive visual quality, appeal, and gameplay readability across all player-facing art
  • Apply deep expertise in the art style across art, animation, VFX, visual storytelling, and character-driven experiences
  • Balance artistic ambition with technical requirements and production realities
  • Build, lead, and mentor high-performing internal and external art teams
  • Direct co-development partners, vendors, and distributed creative talent to deliver consistently high-quality work
  • Partner across design, narrative, audio, engineering, product, and IP to ensure art strengthens the player experience
  • Provide clear visual feedback through reviews, paintovers, references, and development guidance
  • Maintain deep awareness of the art style, creative influences, and evolving player expectations

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, QA Engineering & Automation
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior QA Manager, Automation & Tooling to join our team supporting a soon-to-be-announced AAA mobile game title. This role can be remote in the US and Canada, or hybrid in Culver City.

You will lead the automation strategy for a live game, building the people, processes, frameworks, and tooling required to scale quality across frequent releases and a large, active player base. You will partner closely with Engineering, QA, Live Operations, and other disciplines to establish a development culture where automation is a shared responsibility and a core component of product quality.

At Scopely, we create and operate games played by millions of people around the world. This role is an opportunity to shape how quality engineering evolves from the ground up for a high-scale live mobile game.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute the QA automation strategy for a live mobile game, including scalable frameworks, tooling, standards, and quality gates.
  • Build and lead an automation team from the ground up, including hiring, team structure, processes, mentorship, and career development.
  • Design, build, and implement automated testing across UI, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, and live-operations workflows.
  • Evaluate automation approaches, frameworks, platforms, and traditional or AI-assisted tools based on coverage, maintainability, speed, and value.
  • Establish automation standards, coding practices, test architecture, reporting, observability, and quality gates that can scale with the game and organization.

  • Mentor manual testers as they develop coding and automation skills, while defining metrics for coverage, stability, flakiness, execution time, and defect detection.

  • Champion quality and release excellence across the organization while ensuring automation supports—not replaces—strong exploratory and risk-based testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in QA, test automation, or quality engineering, including 4+ years leading or building automation teams.
  • Proven experience creating automation strategies, frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure for complex products, ideally from the ground up.
  • Experience evaluating automation app

jobs.title: Director, Senior Employment Counsel (Global)
jobs.description:

You will work out of our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis. What you will do:

  • Develop and update region-specific policies, handbooks, contracts, and procedures.
  • Advise on strategic workforce planning, organizational design, restructuring, and M&A activity.
  • Advise on works councils, unions and CBAs across the regions.
  • Monitor and communicate regional legal developments and proactively adjust policies and practices to remain compliant.

What we are looking for:

  • Law degree with admission to practice in at least one jurisdiction
  • In-office presence required 2-3 days per week in Barcelona, Spain. Relocation available
  • Minimum 14 years of progressive experience in global employment law
  • Proven success advising on complex, cross-border employment issues in a global, matrixed environment
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
  • Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability and a deep understanding of risk management
  • Excellent negotiation skills and resilience in partnering with the business
  • Fluency in English required; professional proficiency in Spanish required, fluency preferred. Additional languages are a plus
  • Prior in-house and M&A experience preferred
  • Experience in the technology and/or games industry is a plus

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

jobs.title: Sr.Client Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Location: Tokyo, Japan(On-board in China)

Scopely's Security team is looking for a Sr Client Security Engineer to build a new client security function in China. You will design and ship client/server-side protections for large-scale mobile games, combat sophisticated cheating ecosystems, and help ensure fair play for tens of millions of players.

What You Will Do

  • Build, and grow the Client Security team in China, setting China specific technical direction, and operational best practices.
  • Design, implement, and maintain client-side detections against third‑party cheating tools, modified clients, hooking frameworks, and emulators on Android and iOS.
  • Own the client security integration into Scopely's internal anti-cheat platforms working closely with teams to ensure detections are actionable and scalable.
  • Define and evolve the obfuscation and hardening strategy for China mobile builds (e.g., binary protection, anti-debugging, anti-tamper, integrity checks), including evaluating and integrating third‑party hardening vendors where appropriate.
  • Build and maintain strong coverage for the China mobile ecosystem, including:
    • distribution through multiple Android app stores and OEM devices,
    • diverse OS/ROM variants and rooted/jailbroken environments,
    • and local PC/emulator-based cheating patterns.
  • Contribute hands-on code (C++ plus Java/Kotlin and/or Objective‑C/Swift) in security‑sensitive paths, including detection logic, integrity checks, and secure client–server protocols.

What You Will Need

  • Experience in mobile security, game anti-cheat, or client-side security engineering, including time working directly on Android or iOS native code.
  • Direct experience with reverse engineering.
  • Deep hands-on experience with:
    • Android and IOS internals
    • hooking and instrumentation frameworks,
    • and common mobile client security attack vectors.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ and at least one mobile native language (Java/Kotlin for Android or Objective‑C/Swift for iOS), including experience shipping production code in large apps.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and shipping client-side anti-cheat or integrity systems that integrate with server-side enforcement or analytics pipelines.
  • Prior experience ing or technically directing a small engineering team
  • Experience working with large-scale telemetry or anti-abuse pipelines and using data to tune detections and reduce false positives.
  • Professional proficiency in both Mandarin and English, written and spoken
  • Requires five days per week in the office
  • Requires relocation to Tokyo

  • 开发和推动面向动画制作与效率工具、调试流程方案，帮助团队更高质量、更高效率地完成内容实现

  • 具备从效果目标出发，进行技术抽象与方案判断的能力，能够在动画表现、玩法需求、实现成本与长期可维护性之间做出合理权衡
  • 具备扎实的 Unreal Engine 经验，熟悉蓝图、动画状态机、IK 工作流、角色物理、镜头相关等实现
  • 熟悉 Maya 绑定工作流程与相关功能使用，理解角色绑定与动画系统的基础实现逻辑
  • 优秀的跨职能沟通与协作能力

优先条件

  • 有主导角色绑定系统开发的经验，或具备基于 Maya 的 Python 脚本开发能力
  • 熟悉风格化角色或变形角色的绑定方案与实现方式
  • 有影视叙事、表演类高规格角色制作流程的相关经验

We believe that illuminating the globally diverse experiences, behaviors, and needs of players is critical to Riot living up to our player-focused mission. We're a group united by our love of games, science, and helping others succeed.

As a Principal Insights Analyst on League of Legends, you’ll join the League Insights team – a group of researchers, analysts, ML engineers and data engineers, responsible for solving complex problems and enabling Rioters to make difficult decisions with confidence.

jobs.title: Senior Game Producer 高级游戏项目管理经理 - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:

That's where you come in.

作为 Riot Games 的 Game Producer，我们通过专业的制作管理与跨职能协作，支持团队打造高质量的产品与体验，推动开发工作有序开展，并帮助团队持续改进工作方式。

你将与团队管理者及不同专业领域的负责人紧密合作，协调跨职能工作，推动关键计划与里程碑落地，并与其他项目管理人员协同解决问题、持续优化团队的工作机制。

此外，你还将指导和培养项目管理团队成员，支持不同专业领域的同事改进工作流程、加强协作，并提升团队整体的执行效率。

  • 制定并维护项目制作路线图： 负责为复杂、多阶段的研发项目制定清晰、完整的制作路线图，涵盖开发阶段、关键里程碑及阶段评审节点。将产品目标转化为不同时间维度下切实可行的执行计划，基于经验进行合理评估，并透明地沟通各项目标及里程碑的交付信心与潜在风险。确保团队计划与工作室及 Riot 整体规划保持一致。
  • 设计并优化研发管理体系与流程： 灵活运用 Agile、Lean、Scrum、Kanban 及里程碑管理等方法，根据团队所处的研发阶段调整管理方式。与团队管理层合作，建立、推广并持续优化开发流程、项目管理工具（如 Jira）及跨职能协作机制。制定清晰的目标与衡量指标，持续提升流程效率。

任职要求（Required Qualifications）

  • 拥有 5 年及以上游戏开发相关工作经验，其中包括在设计、美术、工程等跨职能团队中承担制作管理、项目管理或项目群管理工作的丰富经验。
  • 具备研发探索或新游戏项目开发经验，曾参与游戏项目开发及相关内容制作，并能够适应项目范围和方向的频繁变化。
  • 具有制定和维护中长期项目路线图及执行计划的成功经验，能够协调多个专业领域，并按照预期质量标准可靠地推进交付。
  • 具备实际设计、搭建和优化研发流程及工作体系的经验，能够根据团队发展阶段和实际需求灵活运用 Agile、Lean 等管理方法。
  • 具备跨团队风险与依赖关系管理经验，能够清晰沟通不同方案的权衡取舍，并及时提出可执行的解决方案及升级建议。

  • 具备能够满足日常业务沟通及协作需求的中文（普通话）和英语能力。

加分项 (Desired Qualifications):

  • 具备与分布式团队或跨地区团队合作的经验，能够有效协调不同时区和文化背景下的工作。

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

PRODUCTION

What We Do

Whether it’s driving a vision from start to finish or collaborating with teams to inspire and deliver projects of Epic quality, Epic’s production teams take pride in consistently delivering world-class products and experiences.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a quality-focused Senior Release Manager to work closely with our producers, programmers, build engineers, and QA teams to oversee the build and release process for the Fortnite Ecosystem. In this position, you will work directly with the brightest technical minds in the business as we build the premier game engine for a multitude of platforms.

In this role, you will

  • Develop new practices and structures to better scale release management and stabilization processes across our Game Dev ecosystem, while managing a sub-team of release managers
  • Own the scheduling, coordination, quality control, and external certification process across multiple platforms and/or products
  • Act as the liaison between multiple development teams, coordinating and negotiating development plans, exceptions, sales/mktg/publishing content, as well as releases
  • Work with the publishing and development teams to determine release content plans as related to sales, giveaways, promotions, etc., and shepherd that content through external party approvals for release
  • Work closely with QA, Build Engineers, and Lead Programmers to monitor the automated build and integration process, facilitate the resolution of build failures, and understand and communicate the impact of branches and code merges
  • Partner with QA Leads to establish and maintain the bug triage process and prioritize must-fix issues, coordinate internal and external release notes, known issues, and knowledge base updates, and ensure releases have passed all required checks and approvals leading up to live deployment, while communicating approved exceptions to all necessary parties

What we're looking for

  • Strong production/project management skills, communication skills, and people management/direct report experience
  • Demonstrated ability in right-sized process development and improvement

DATA SCIENCE INTERN

We are looking for a Data Science Intern to join the Ecosystem Security team supporting initiatives related to fraud and abuse detection. As part of the EcoSec team, you will be given a detection problem to own as part of our development cycle.   • Analyze and resolve stability and performance problems of Fortnite on a wide range of PC hardware configurations; this includes identifying solutions in such areas as:
    • Solving device-specific CPU and GPU performance and compatibility issues
    • Rendering performance and device compatibility, including the shader pipeline
    • Improving rendering systems and optimizing their stability and performance across various graphics APIs
    • Improvements in low-level systems that interface with platform APIs, i.e., memory allocators (physical and virtual), file systems, and input systems
  • Monitor stability and performance data from Fortnite releases and improve Unreal Engine’s systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Work with GPU vendors and other partners to resolve technical issues and collaborate on improving underlying technologies, such as graphics drivers for Fortnite and Unreal Engine
  • Assess performance data across various hardware and improve Unreal Engine’s rendering systems and applications in Fortnite-specific use cases
  • Collaborate with a variety of other Epic teams, such as Unreal Engine’s Rendering Architecture team, to help them solve complex technical challenges in ways that move the stability and quality of Fortnite and our internal products forward

What we're looking for

  • Strong C++ knowledge and multi-thread

jobs.title: Lead Technical Animator
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for a Lead Technical Animator with a passion for expressive character movement to join our team. In this talented team of veteran and emerging artists, you’ll collaborate across teams and contribute directly to Fortnite and other initiatives as part of our collaboration with Disney. Joining this team means you’re motivated to seek solutions to problems and work with other disciplines to make positive changes to workflows, tools, and technologies that directly impact cosmetic assets and gameplay.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with technical animators, Leads, Directors, and Outsource Managers on the team to ensure assets are set up for success in the different stages of production
  • Communicate and drive alignment around strategy for technical animation and adjacent cosmetics teams
  • Work with production to schedule, prioritize, and delegate assets for the team, both internal and vendor
  • Work closely with animators, modelers, and designers to ensure a smooth development pipeline that delivers high-quality assets
  • Assisting with pipeline tools and working with engine and project leads on the continuous improvement of those engine tools
  • Mentor rigging-focused technical animators
  • Rigging characters, weapons, creatures, and vehicles
  • Setting up assets in Unreal Engine 5; including control rigs, cloth, physics, and blueprints
  • Maintain detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support internal and external artists

What we're looking for

  • Extensive experience rigging characters in Maya and/or Unreal Engine
  • A portfolio demonstrating rigging for a range of characters, bipeds, and creatures, both body and faces
  • Attention to aesthetic detail, especially with regard to character deformation and physics movement
  • Familiarity with the Unreal Engine 5 art pipeline
  • A positive individual with strong written communication and teamwork skills
  • Exceptional problem-solver

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer, Combat – Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Game Designer, you will design, tweak, and optimize the player experience. Your analytical skills, player insight, and creativity help craft in- and out-of-game experiences that engage and surprise players. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and work with every tool at hand to create and iterate player-focused designs that will delight millions around the world.

As a Senior Game Designer, Combat on the Unpublished R&D Product team, you will design, prototype, and refine engaging player experiences through creative problem-solving and thoughtful game design. You will translate high-level creative goals into actionable design solutions, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to develop and iterate on high-quality game content. You will apply your design expertise and player insights to establish best practices, address design challenges, and deliver cohesive player experiences. You will report into the Game Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, and iterate on gameplay experiences and systems, ensuring high standards of quality, clarity, and player engagement.
  • Explore innovative game design approaches, evaluate potential solutions, and articulate trade-offs and risks.
  • Establish design principles, best practices, and workflows to support consistent quality and efficient development.
  • Utilize rapid prototyping, playtesting, and feedback to evaluate and improve design solutions.
  • Create clear design documentation that can be evaluated and implemented by cross-functional partners.
  • Collaborate with game design and other disciplines to align on design goals, address challenges, and continuously improve the player experience.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in game design.
  • Strong understanding of game design principles, player experience, and gameplay systems.
  • 3+ years of experience with Unreal Engine, including Blueprint or equivalent development tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to design

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Principal Al Engineer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine. You'll design and ship the full stack of systems that let LLMs act inside the engine (from end to end, not just a single layer), bringing depth in game engine architecture, cloud services, and how LLMs actually work.

In this role, you will

  • Design and build LLM-driven agents and tools that operate directly inside Unreal Engine, including engine-side C++/Python tooling and editor scripting
  • Architect and extend the cloud-hosted agent harness, services, and database that mediate between LLMs and the engine
  • Work across the full stack (engine tooling, cloud backend, and the web UI used to drive and monitor agents) to ship end-to-end features
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging LLM capabilities (tool use, multi-agent orchestration, context management) into Epic's engine and pipeline tooling
  • Define technical direction for the reliability, safety, and evaluation of LLM-driven engine automation
  • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend engineers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

What we're looking for

  • Strong programming background with hands-on experience in a game engine (Unreal Engine strongly preferred), including engine architecture and tooling/editor scripting
  • Practical experience building or shipping products powered by LLMs (agents, tool-calling, RAG, prompt/context engineering), or a strong conceptual understanding of how LLMs work
  • Experience with cloud-native services and infrastructure: web APIs, databases, and service architecture and deployment

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

jobs.title: Senior Technical Game Designer - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Game Designer, you will design, tweak, and optimize the player experience. Your analytical skills, player insight, and creativity aid in crafting in- and out-of-game experiences that engage and surprise players. You will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams and work with every tool at hand to innovate and iterate player-focused designs that'll delight millions around the world.

As a Senior Technical Game Designer on the Unpublished R&D Product team, you will help turn ambitious design ideas into playable, sustainable game experiences. You will work across multiple areas of game design, partnering with designers, engineers, artists, and production to prototype new ideas, implement technically complex features, and improve how the design team builds and iterates content. This is a game design role with significant technical responsibilities. You will use your design judgment and technical fluency to bridge design intent and implementation constraints, reduce development dependencies, and help the team make informed trade-offs. You will report into the Game Director of the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, implement, and iterate on game features and supporting systems across multiple areas of game design.
  • Build and improve designer-facing tools, workflows, debugging capabilities, and validation processes that increase the quality and velocity of the design team.
  • Own technically complex design features from initial framing through implementation, testing, refinement, and delivery.
  • Work with design and product leadership to explore ambiguous problem spaces and turn promising ideas into playable prototypes.
  • Develop multiple design and technical solutions, clearly communicating their player impact, trade-offs, risks, scope, and long-term maintenance considerations.
  • Identify technical constraints, cross-system dependencies, and implementation risks early, and translate them into actionable design decisions.
  • Establish reusable implementation patterns, best practices, and quality standards

FamXP, the Family Experience team within Trust, Safety, and Support, is responsible for the safety, privacy, and age-appropriate experience of kids and families across Epic's products. jobs.title: Manager, Quality Assurance - VALORANT
jobs.description:
At Riot, we believe Quality is a set of values, practices, and behaviors that inform every part of the development process. By honing our craft of quality and demonstrating cross-discipline partnerships we help Riot sustainably craft excellent experiences for players, globally.

As a Manager of Quality Assurance on VALORANT, you will lead quality strategy and people across some of VALORANT’s most technically complex and cross-cutting domains. You will manage quality owners responsible for a variety of areas within the game and your primary focus will be on the Game Engine, Technical Art, and Release Engineering that power VALORANT. You will be accountable for defining and executing a comprehensive test strategy that supports multiple cross-functional development teams, while shaping and promoting the vision of quality assurance across Riot—so that, “Gamers worldwide know that every experience they have with Riot will be a quality experience.” You will also ensure the execution of all test coverage within your product space, including playtest activities, manage testing, telemetry, defect data and report regularly on product quality. You will mentor your reports on the testing activities needed to support production within the teams you support. You will report into Riot Sydney Studio Leadership for VALORANT.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage QA professionals working across multiple teams and areas of VALORANT, with a specific focus on Foundations.
  • Hold teams accountable for upholding quality and player impact as an essential factor in decision-making
  • Partner with other craft leaders to influence craft and product decisions through quality insights and risk analysis
  • Assesses quality, risk, and complexity, and communicates clear mitigations and priorities to development teams and leadership
  • Coaches and supports direct reports through complex quality challenges, representing their plans and needs with initiative leadership
  • Partners with other disciplines to improve development workflows and define quality bars or targets that align with initiative goals
  • Monitors quality health and defect trends, maintaining data-driven reporting and continuous improvement systems that inform decision-making
  • Drives quality feature planning and executes testing coverage plans with teams

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years Quality Assurance Experience, with experience in a leadership role
  • Performance test tooling and automation
  • Experience creating test strategies for products
  • Experience with test design, planning and control
  • Experience with product development pipelines and workflows
  • Experience managing performance of embedded QA professionals
  • Experience working with remote testing teams
  • Experience establishing quality metrics that influence strategy and drive change

ENGINEERING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of engineering experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Senior Tools Programmer to evolve artist tools within the Unreal Editor, particularly in geometry and texturing processing, terrain authoring, and procedural generation. An important aspect of this role is supporting both user-driven and agentic workflows, including exploring and implementing new interaction paradigms to accelerate content creation. You'll directly impact artist productivity by developing user-facing tools for one of the leading game engines used by developers worldwide.

In this role, you will

  • Support and extend existing artist tools for internal and external users
  • Refactor existing tools to be more accessible and effective for agentic workflows
  • Create new tools at the intersection of user-driven and agent-driven content creation
  • Collaborate with artists on internal projects and productions
  • Work with other developers across team boundaries on shared initiatives
  • Contribute to major initiatives that shape the future of the Unreal Editor

What we're looking for

  • Excellent C++ skills
  • Strong background in developing artist tools within the games or film industry
  • Experience with geometry processing, texture processing, or procedural generation
  • Fluency in using current agentic tools and workflows for programming tasks
  • Track record of exploring and applying AI capabilities to advance artist workflows
  • Experience developing in a large codebase
  • Ability to work independently and deliver effectively as part of a distributed team
  • Experience working collaboratively to deliver high-quality outcomes across teams

This team delivers both player-facing ML experiences and developer-facing ML tools, enabling in-game and around-game capabilities such as recommendations, player behavior modeling, matchmaking, and experimentation-driven personalization.

In this role, you will be accountable for the technical vision, execution, and business impact of ML applications in League of Legends. You will shape the end-to-end ML engineering strategy, from data and feature pipelines to model development, deployment, evaluation, and operations, ensuring systems are scalable, reliable, and measurable in production. You will partner with development themes’ product and production leaders to enable the development of League of Legends existing and future player experiences.

You will report to the Data Engineering Director of League Insights. This role is based out of our Los Angeles Headquarters.

jobs.title: Hard Surface Outsource Lead
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modelling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modeling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a Senior Tech Artist to join our team working on Fortnite Events. A successful candidate should have a deep knowledge in look development, lighting and complex game art. A successful candidate should have a broad knowledge of art creation for games. You should understand modeling, texturing, and animation fundamentals. You should be able to combine geometry, materials, effects, and UE Blueprints to create complex art. You should be able to work with both internal ICs, leads and directors as well as direct vendors to support the more technical aspects of creating art.

In this role, you will

  • Create complex materials for landscape and environments
  • Be responsible for world lighting, sets lighting, clouds, atmospherics, water lookdev
  • Execute on a range of visual styles with emphasis on stylized with a high level of fidelity
  • Work with engineers and artists to optimize content for many platforms
  • Own gameplay and engine features from the TechArt side maintaining the high-quality bar for Fortnite Events

What we're looking for

  • Must have a strong reel/portfolio showing executed game tech art
  • Experienced knowledge of PBR principles and material editors
  • Establish workflows and tools for other artists to utilize when making unique assets
  • Experience using texturing packagers such as Substance Designer
  • High level of proficiency in setting up world environmental lighting
  • Desire and knowledge of how to push Unreal Engine further
  • Desire to work with a team and own features and initiatives from inception to ship
  • Familiarity with the Unreal 5 Engine art pipeline
  • Experience working on multiple platforms
  • Scripting experience Blueprint or other

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Memory
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

As foundation models move from answering questions to acting over long horizons, memory becomes a central requirement. Systems must decide what is worth keeping and improve from experience. Large context windows and retrieval systems are not enough. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory.

In this role, you will

  • Design new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products
  • Define new ways to measure and evaluate memory performance
  • Help create and deliver production-ready, scalable and high-quality learning models and associated algorithms
  • Critically assess the effectiveness of such models and make recommendations for the ongoing roadmap

What we're looking for

  • PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics or related field, or 3+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Experience creating machine learning algorithms for vision and/or language problems and deploying them as production-level systems
  • Expert, hands-on knowledge of:
    • Foundational models and vision and/or language, incl. local deployment and model post-training of open weights models
    • Memory, state, or long-horizon behaviour in foundation models: your experience may come from language agents and long-context methods, reinforcement learning under partial observability, world models, or sequence modelling
    • Python and associated ML tools/frameworks (numpy, scipy, sklearn, pytorch)
  • Experience with working collaboratively with other developers, following a flexible and agile approach

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager - Publishing Platform, Content Access Platform
jobs.location: Los Angeles, USA; Mercer Island, USA
jobs.description:
Technical Product Managers combine deep technical knowledge with product leadership to deliver key Riot Games products and experiences that make it better to be a player. Technical Product Managers drive strategic vision across Riot's products and technologies. By leading multidisciplinary teams, they solve complex technical and user-experience challenges to deliver impactful solutions.

As a Principal Technical Product Manager on the Commerce (Store) team, you will own and operate large-scale, distributed services that support millions of Riot players worldwide, enabling them to purchase digital goods such as champions and cosmetics within their favorite games. Working closely with game studios, you’ll help identify and deliver platform solutions that prioritize efficiency, scalability, and reliability for developers, while powering in-game experiences across all of Riot’s titles. Your primary focus will be on Storefront experiences across numerous channels within the Riot ecosystem, as well as the critical inventory fulfillment systems that support them. Your expertise will extend across adjacent Commerce product spaces including inventory, payments, battle pass, loyalty systems, fraud, gifting, and configuration management. You will report to the Director of Technical Product Management of the Commerce team within Publishing Platform.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and align product strategy for critical, cross-cutting platform areas, prioritizing outcomes that create measurable value for developers and players
  • Bring strategic structure and clarity to Commerce's hardest, most ambiguous initiatives so they're set up for long-term success
  • Lead a team of engineers to design, build, and operate critical microservices for managing store, inventory fulfillment, and randomization based systems for Riot’s players and fans
  • Partner deeply with engineering leads to ensure platform solutions are robust, scalable, and seamlessly integrated into developer workflows
  • Work with teams of experts across the company to design, prototype, build, and ship new features
  • Help ensure that your team is consistently executing with excellence
  • Be part of a rotational on-call schedule for live product and internal customer support when required
  • Work with technical and non-technical customers to understand their requirements and design solutions that fit their needs
  • Own and communicate the product vision, mission, strategy, and multi-year roadmap in partnership with other Commerce product leads

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in Technical Product Management or a related engineering/technical field
  • Experience leading backend engineering teams to design, build, operate, and maintain large scale microservice ecosystems
  • Proven ability to operate at a Principal level, navigating organizational c

jobs.title: Manager, Application Engineering - ​​Atlassian Cloud Platform
jobs.description:
As Manager, Atlassian Cloud Platform, you will lead the team responsible for the strategy, administration, governance, delivery, and operational health of Riot’s Atlassian Platform which currently includes Jira. You will manage a team of application engineers, administrators, solution architects, and/or analysts who partner with teams across Riot to build scalable systems of work, improve the Rioter experience, and enable better outcomes through thoughtful use of Atlassian technology.

Jira is a foundational enterprise capability for planning, delivering, and operating work across Riot. Jira supports and enables the majority of player-facing value streams at Riot.

This is a player/coach role where you will set direction and create the conditions for your team to deliver, while maintaining enough craft depth to guide platform architecture, configuration, automation, integrations, security, service management, and operational decisions. You will partner closely with Information Technology, Information Security, Enterprise, and teams across Riot to balance customer needs, platform standards, risk, capacity, and near-term business priorities.

For this role, success means building a healthy, high-performing team; delivering a dependable Jira platform; establishing clear and scalable governance; and providing a frictionless environment for our game teams and the teams that support them. Ultimately, you win when teams at Riot spend less time blocked and more time making great games for players.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and evolve a team of 2-5 application engineers; coaching them, providing performance management, identifying growth opportunities, and ensuring positive results
  • Own the interviewing and onboarding process for new engineering team members
  • Establish healthy team processes for intake, prioritization, discovery, solution design, delivery, change management, documentation, and support.
  • Deliver platform capabilities and improvements against clear commitments, keeping stakeholders informed of progress, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and changes in priority.
  • Plan for keep-the-lights-on work, technical debt, platform maintenance, licensing needs, and other necessary technical investments alongside roadmap delivery.
  • Facilitate alignment across teams when platform decisions affect multiple business units, Jira spaces, service portals, integrations, or governance domains.
  • Build strong relationships with Atlassian and relevant vendors; manage vendor performance, escalations, and technical direction.
  • Advocate for the team while ensuring decisions optimize for Riot and player value rather than for a single team or local preference.
  • Be accountable for the team’s output and successful delivery against commitments.
  • Promote contextual awareness of Riot’s company priorities, Information Technology strategy, Atlassian industry trends

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - EPIC GAMES SERVICES

What We Do

Driving the plug-in power behind Unreal Engine 5. We bridge connections for licensees and our own internal game teams to online services. This allows games like Fortnite to utilize a combination of platform online services as well as Epic’s own online services to build cross-platform online features. Login, parties, voice chat, matchmaking, purchasing, cloud storage, and analytics are just a few examples of online features that our Online Game Services team helps games utilize.

What You'll Do

The Applications Team builds desktop and web applications, as well as supporting online services to power content discovery and digital delivery. Our team of engineering experts is always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower internal and external developers to deliver their digital content to users across multiple platforms. Whether it be supporting Fortnite, the Epic Games Store, or external partners, we are committed to improving the scalability, efficiency, portability, and stability of our tech offerings. As a member of our Applications team, you can expect to coordinate with a cross-site group of highly skilled individuals. You will have opportunities to architect new features and evolve existing products used daily by millions of gamers, developers, and enterprise professionals. You will partner closely with backend services teams to ensure that the underlying systems we build meet internal and external customer needs.

In this role, you will

  • Focus on the technical implementation and evolution of the Epic Games Launcher desktop application
  • Be hands-on and use your technical expertise to drive solutions for a range of challenges
  • Collaborate with other teams (including Product, Design, QA, and Backend Service Teams)
  • Design, architect, implement, and ship well-documented new features
  • Improve, and evolve existing tools and features
  • Maintain and hunt for bugs in existing code bases
  • Take part in foundational work as we embark on a new chapter for our desktop clients

What we're looking for

  • Experience building perfect experience-focused desktop applications, as well as strong professional experience building production softwar

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ONLINE INFRASTRUCTURE

What We Do

We enable Epic’s online services teams to build, deploy, and manage services that are used by more than half a billion players around the world. Our mission is to provide world class tools and platforms to improve the experience of our developers and make it easier, faster, and safer to build, operate, and scale their applications. We operate at massive scale as one of the largest cloud computing users in the world.

What You'll Do

As Technical Lead / Principal Engineer on the Al Engineering team, you'll provide technical leadership and strategic vision for the Al-powered platforms, tools and services that accelerate development velocity and productivity across Epic. You'll guide a team of engineers in building high-impact products like unified Al code review systems, Cloud agent hosting, centralized Al knowledge base and developer experience tools that serve thousands of folks across the company. This role sits at the intersection of Al innovation, practical engineering, and technical leadership. You'll set the technical direction for tools that developers across Epic use every day, establish best practices for Al-powered development tooling, mentor engineers, and shape how thousands of engineers write, review, and ship code. On top of that you'll be hands-on building complex aspects of the systems and working heavily with Al agents to implement, test, release, and operate these critical platforms.

In this role, you will

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural vision for production-grade AI developer tools used by thousands of engineers across Epic's major codebases (Unreal Engine, Fortnite, and more)
  • Drive architectural decisions for scalable, maintainable developer-facing tools across multiple modalities: CLI and desktop tools, web apps, build process integrations, services, and APIs
  • Pioneer and establish patterns for modern AI frameworks and agent architectures, setting standards for the broader team
  • Partner with leadership and high-value teams to identify strategic opportunities and design/build/validate new platforms
  • Design and implement security, governance, and compliance protocols for AI platforms, including secret management, workload identity, and runtime isolation policies
  • Define me

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Game Designer to join our Music team, contributing across various aspects of highly social and music-based gameplay and interactive experiences. In this role, you will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to shape and refine music systems, tune gameplay mechanics, craft engaging activities and social experiences, and ensure compelling and expressive player experiences.

In this role, you will

  • Own the design and hands-on implementation of music-based gameplay features and systems, including using Jam Tracks, music interaction mechanics, and social music experiences, while fostering innovation
  • Effectively communicate project vision to team members across all disciplines, collaborating closely with audio, engineering, art, UX, and product teams to ensure compelling player experiences and overall ecosystem health
  • Set and maintain high-quality standards for music gameplay and social interaction design, actively participating in big-picture decisions to drive superior results
  • Create clear, structured design documents and drive collaborative, iterative prototyping processes to rapidly explore and refine music systems, player interactions, and emergent gameplay opportunities
  • Design and tune systems that support music gameplay, progression, discovery, and player expression, leveraging data and playtest feedback to react quickly to changing project needs and drive effective solutions
  • Partner closely with audio and engineering teams to develop intuitive tools and mechanics that empower players to create, remix, and engage with music-driven experiences

What we're looking for

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience shipping multiple titles as a game designer, with expertise in systems design and multiplayer gameplay, ideally including music gameplay, rhythm mechanics, social experiences, and player expression features

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PRODUCT MANAGEMENT

What We Do

Product Management partners with game development, publishing, marketing, and platform teams to provide a data and market-driven view of product strategy that aligns with business goals. As part of Epic’s Growth Team, we use our product expertise to identify and drive growth levers to grow our player base and business.

What You'll Do

As a Director of Product Management, you will be a key leader within the Discovery product org. You will help define the strategy and flywheel of the Discovery system, working closely with Development, Design, and Data Science teams to ship features and optimize systems that connect players with the right content at the right time. You will translate high-level strategic goals into actionable roadmaps, write detailed requirements, and drive cross-functional execution. You will partner with marketing, content strategy, and creator initiatives teams to ensure their needs are reflected in the product.

In this role, you will

  • Own product strategy and execution for defined areas of the Discover surface, developing roadmaps that improve player discovery and drive growth
  • Write detailed business and product requirements that guide design and technical specifications, partnering directly with Development and Data Science to ship high-quality systems and features
  • Develop and refine "playbooks" and operational strategies that leverage Discover features to achieve initiative goals, using data to measure effectiveness and iterate
  • Build and present product and feature concepts to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, clearly articulating impact, rationale, and expected outcomes
  • Drive live operations execution for Discover initiatives, ensuring consistent quality and identifying opportunities for improvement through data analysis

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, with meaningful exposure to discovery systems, content platforms, recommendation engines, or large-scale consumer products
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform product decisions, define success metrics, and evaluate feature performance
  • Passion for games and a solid understanding of growth, retention, and moneti

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling gameplay experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, programming, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on gameplay systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

As a UI Artist, you will collaborate with UX designers to design features and UX/UI systems by generating high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, design systems, and style guides. You will assist the UI Technical Designers and UI Engineers to build out the designs into rapid prototypes and shippable UI to players.   • Contribute to shipping high-quality features on time
  • Collaborate with the greater UXUI Department to ensure consistency and quality are maintained across the project
  • Execute at a high-quality bar, work autonomously, and tackle complex features and systems
  • Work in Photoshop, Illustrator, and/or Figma to create concept UI art

What we're looking for

  • You have 2+ years of experience working collaboratively to create UI from concept to completion
  • Excellent visual design skills with a strong portfolio
  • You are skilled with Figma, Adobe Suite, or other comparable software
  • A strong portfolio of work showcasing your skills and your process
  • Experience with UI Art implementation, in Unreal Engine (UMG) or equivalent game engine
  • Experience with building UI materials & shaders for game engines, or equivalent 3d packages and FX tools; motion design & UI animation, preferably for games or interaction design
  • You have the ability to see features through to completion and rapidly modify work as information changes

jobs.description:

MARKETING

What We Do

We deliver the most innovative gaming experiences possible to players around the world. Whether through community outreach, world-class events, or partnership integrations, the Epic Games Publishing and Marketing teams seek to surprise players with new experiences every time they drop in to play.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking a highly strategic, culturally fluent, and operationally rigorous Influencer Marketing Director to lead creator and talent partnerships across Fortnite. This role will shape how creators, streamers, athletes, musicians, entertainers, and their communities connect with Fortnite through major launches, live-service moments, partnerships, and creator campaigns.

The ideal candidate combines deep fluency in the Fortnite creator ecosystem with strong strategic judgment, communication skills, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. This person should understand both gaming culture and broader entertainment ecosystems, and be equally comfortable building creator strategy, managing high-profile talent relationships, and navigating complex cross-functional initiatives.

In this role, you will

  • Develop and lead creator and influencer strategies tied to Fortnite launches, partnerships, live-service beats, and major campaigns
  • Translate brand and business objectives into measurable creator programs that drive audience engagement, conversation, and commercial impact
  • Build and manage relationships with key gaming creators, streamers, athletes, entertainers, agents, and talent representatives across multiple verticals
  • Lead high-profile creator and talent integrations from planning through execution, including negotiations, hospitality, experiential activations, and content coordination
  • Present creator strategies, talent recommendations, and campaign plans clearly and concisely to senior leadership
  • Partner cross-functionally across Paid Media, Brand Marketing, Competitive, IP Partnerships teams and external partners to deliver cohesive global campaigns
  • Manage agency partners and oversee campaign execution to ensure work meets Epic’s creative, operational, and business standards

jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

LEGAL

What We Do

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

What You'll Do

Epic’s regulatory team advises the company on newly enacted laws and regulations around the world as well as works alongside our Public Policy Team to monitor regulatory developments. Partnering closely with our subject matter experts, Product Counsel and Compliance Team, you will manage the design of compliance programs and educate counsel regarding regulatory requirements. You will also assist with the company’s response to regulatory investigations and requests for information from regulators.

In this role, you will

  • Advise Epic senior management, Product Counsel, the Compliance Team and Legal leadership on key global laws and regulations, including online safety frameworks
  • Lead multi-stakeholder regulatory compliance strategies
  • Provide legal analysis of legislative and regulatory drafts to the Public Policy team
  • Support advocacy and engagement with regulators and trade associations
  • Respond to global regulatory inquiries and investigations

What we're looking for

  • A qualified attorney with at least 8 years of experience working in regulatory compliance, either within a regulatory body, in-house or at a law firm
  • Experience handling regulatory enforcement actions brought by regulatory bodies
  • Prior work and/or substantial knowledge of the tech industry; A good working knowledge of tech or videogames is an advantage
  • An individual who is comfortable working in a multi-stakeholder environment, navigating complex issues, driving high-risk/impact projects, and working and making sound judgments and decisions in ambiguous situations where clear guidance is lacking or may not exist
  • Must be able to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with a broad range of individuals and teams

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
